LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models VLA

Latent Chain-of-Thought Reinforcement Learning VLA models Physical reasoning Robotic manipulation

简要说明：提出LaST-R1，一个VLA框架，集成自适应潜在物理推理和新颖RL算法（LAPO），联合优化推理和动作生成，在机器人操作基准和现实任务上展现出强大性能。

TLDR: Proposes LaST-R1, a VLA framework that integrates adaptive latent physical reasoning and a novel RL algorithm (LAPO) to jointly optimize reasoning and action generation, demonstrating strong performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. While online reinforcement learning (RL) has been introduced to VLAs to enable trial-and-error exploration, current methods exclusively optimize the vanilla action space, bypassing the underlying physical reasoning process. In this paper, we present \textbf{LaST-R1}, a unified VLA framework that integrates latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning over physical dynamics prior to action execution, along with a tailored RL post-training paradigm. Specifically, we propose \textbf{Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization (LAPO)}, a novel RL algorithm that jointly optimizes the latent reasoning process and the action generation. By bridging reasoning and control, LAPO improves the representation of physical world modeling and enhances robustness in interactive environments. Furthermore, an \textbf{adaptive latent CoT mechanism} is introduced to allow the policy to dynamically adjust its reasoning horizon based on environment complexity. Extensive experiments show that LaST-R1 achieves a near-perfect 99.8\% average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark with only one-shot supervised warm-up, significantly improving convergence speed and performance over prior state-of-the-art methods. In real-world deployments, LAPO post-training yields up to a 44\% improvement over the initial warm-up policy across four complex tasks, including both single-arm and dual-arm settings. Finally, LaST-R1 demonstrates strong generalization across simulated and real-world environments.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型在复杂机器人操作任务中正逐步融入推理机制。然而，现有方法存在一个关键局限：无论是采用存在延迟与离散化问题的显式语言推理，还是使用表达能力更强的连续隐空间推理，它们均主要局限于静态模仿学习框架，这限制了模型的适应性与泛化能力。尽管已有研究将在线强化学习引入视觉-语言-动作模型以实现试错探索，但当前方法仅优化原始动作空间，忽略了底层的物理推理过程。本文提出\textbf{LaST-R1}——一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，该框架在执行动作前融合了针对物理动态的隐式思维链推理，并配备了定制化的强化学习后训练范式。具体而言，我们提出\textbf{隐空间-动作策略优化算法}，这是一种新颖的强化学习算法，能联合优化隐空间推理过程与动作生成。通过 bridging 推理与控制环节，该算法改善了物理世界建模的表征能力，并增强了交互环境中的鲁棒性。此外，我们引入\textbf{自适应隐式思维链机制}，使策略能够根据环境复杂度动态调整推理深度。大量实验表明，在仅需单次监督热启动的情况下，LaST-R1 在 LIBERO 基准测试中实现了接近完美的 99.8\% 平均成功率，其收敛速度和性能均显著超越现有先进方法。在现实场景部署中，经过隐空间-动作策略优化的后训练策略在包含单臂与双臂操作的四类复杂任务中，相较初始热启动策略性能提升最高达 44\%。最终，LaST-R1 在仿真与真实环境中均展现出强大的泛化能力。

Authors: Hao Chen, Jiaming Liu, Zhonghao Yan, Nuowei Han, Renrui Zhang, Chenyang Gu, Jialin Gao, Ziyu Guo, Siyuan Qian, Yinxi Wang, Peng Jia, Chi-Wing Fu, Shanghang Zhang, Pheng-Ann Heng

PRTS: A Primitive Reasoning and Tasking System via Contrastive Representations VLA

Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning contrastive representations VLA foundation model goal reachability offline trajectories

简要说明：PRTS将VLA预训练重新定义为目标条件强化学习，利用对比表示从离线轨迹中学习目标可达性，在多个操作基准上实现了最先进的性能。

TLDR: PRTS reformulates VLA pretraining as goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, using contrastive representations to learn goal reachability from offline trajectories, achieving state-of-the-art results on manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic control via strong visual-linguistic priors. However, existing VLAs predominantly frame pretraining as supervised behavior cloning, overlooking the fundamental nature of robot learning as a goal-reaching process that requires understanding temporal task progress. We present \textbf{PRTS} (\textbf{P}rimitive \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{T}asking \textbf{S}ystem), a VLA foundation model that reformulates pretraining through Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning. By treating language instructions as goals and employing contrastive reinforcement learning, PRTS learns a unified embedding space where the inner product of state-action and goal embeddings approximates the log-discounted goal occupancy, the probability of reaching the language-specified goal from the current state-action, quantitatively assessing physical feasibility beyond static semantic matching. PRTS draws this dense goal-reachability supervision directly from offline trajectories without reward annotations, and folds it into the VLM backbone via a role-aware causal mask, incurring negligible overhead over vanilla behavior cloning. This paradigm endows the high-level reasoning system with intrinsic goal reachability awareness, bridging semantic reasoning and temporal task progress, and further benefits goal-conditioned action prediction. Pretrained on 167B tokens of diverse manipulation and embodied-reasoning data, PRTS reaches state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and a real-world suite of 14 complex tasks, with particularly substantial gains on long-horizon, contact-rich, and zero-shot novel-instruction settings, confirming that injecting goal-reachability awareness significantly improves both execution success and long-horizon planning of general-purpose robotic foundation policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过强大的视觉-语言先验知识推动机器人控制的发展。然而，现有VLA模型主要将预训练视为监督式行为克隆，忽视了机器人学习作为目标达成过程的本质特征，即需要理解任务的时间进展。本文提出\textbf{PRTS}（\textbf{P}rimitive \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{T}asking \textbf{S}ystem，原始推理与任务处理系统），一种基于目标条件强化学习重构预训练范式的VLA基础模型。该模型将语言指令视为目标，并采用对比强化学习方法，学习到一个统一的嵌入空间，其中状态-动作与目标嵌入的内积近似于对数折扣目标占据概率——即从当前状态-动作到达语言指定目标的可能性，从而定量评估超越静态语义匹配的物理可行性。PRTS直接从离线轨迹数据中获取密集的目标可达性监督信号，无需奖励标注，并通过角色感知因果掩码将其融入VLM主干网络，在经典行为克隆基础上仅引入可忽略的开销。这一范式使高层推理系统具备内在的目标可达性感知能力，桥接语义推理与任务时间进程，并进一步优化目标条件动作预测。通过在1670亿个涵盖多样化操作与具身推理数据的标记上进行预训练，PRTS在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv及包含14项复杂任务的真实场景测试套件上达到最先进性能，尤其在长时程、密集接触及零样本新指令场景中取得显著提升，证实注入目标可达性感知能力能显著增强通用机器人基础策略的执行成功率与长时程规划能力。

Authors: Yang Zhang, Jiangyuan Zhao, Chenyou Fan, Fangzheng Yan, Tian Li, Haitong Tang, Sen Fu, Xuan'er Wu, Qizhen Weng, Weinan Zhang, Xiu Li, Chi Zhang, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

HERMES++: Toward a Unified Driving World Model for 3D Scene Understanding and Generation AutonomousDriving

driving world model 3D scene understanding BEV representation future geometry prediction LLM-enhanced

简要说明：HERMES++ 是一个统一的驾驶世界模型，将3D场景理解和未来几何预测集成在一个框架中，使用了BEV表示、LLM增强查询和一种新颖的时序链接。

TLDR: HERMES++ is a unified driving world model that integrates 3D scene understanding and future geometry prediction within a single framework, using a BEV representation, LLM-enhanced queries, and a novel temporal link.

Abstract: Driving world models serve as a pivotal technology for autonomous driving by simulating environmental dynamics. However, existing approaches predominantly focus on future scene generation, often overlooking comprehensive 3D scene understanding. Conversely, while Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, they lack the capacity to predict future geometric evolution, creating a significant disparity between semantic interpretation and physical simulation. To bridge this gap, we propose HERMES++, a unified driving world model that integrates 3D scene understanding and future geometry prediction within a single framework. Our approach addresses the distinct requirements of these tasks through synergistic designs. First, a BEV representation consolidates multi-view spatial information into a structure compatible with LLMs. Second, we introduce LLM-enhanced world queries to facilitate knowledge transfer from the understanding branch. Third, a Current-to-Future Link is designed to bridge the temporal gap, conditioning geometric evolution on semantic context. Finally, to enforce structural integrity, we employ a Joint Geometric Optimization strategy that integrates explicit geometric constraints with implicit latent regularization to align internal representations with geometry-aware priors. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method. HERMES++ achieves strong performance, outperforming specialist approaches in both future point cloud prediction and 3D scene understanding tasks. The model and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/HERMESV2.

摘要（中文）：驾驶世界模型通过模拟环境动态成为自动驾驶的关键技术。然而，现有方法主要聚焦于未来场景生成，往往忽视对三维场景的全面理解。相反，尽管大型语言模型展现出卓越的推理能力，却无法预测未来的几何演变，导致语义解释与物理仿真之间存在显著鸿沟。为弥合这一差距，我们提出HERMES++——一个将三维场景理解与未来几何预测整合于统一框架的驾驶世界模型。通过协同设计，我们的方法应对了这些任务的不同需求。首先，鸟瞰图表示将多视角空间信息整合为与大型语言模型兼容的结构；其次，我们引入增强型语言模型世界查询机制，以促进理解分支的知识迁移；第三，设计了当前-未来链接模块来弥合时间间隔，使几何演变受语义上下文调节；最后，为强化结构完整性，我们采用联合几何优化策略，将显式几何约束与隐式潜在正则化相结合，使内部表征与几何感知先验对齐。在多个基准测试上的广泛评估验证了我们方法的有效性。HERMES++在点云未来预测和三维场景理解任务中均表现优异，超越专业模型。相关模型与代码将在https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/HERMESV2公开发布。

Authors: Xin Zhou, Dingkang Liang, Xiwu Chen, Feiyang Tan, Dingyuan Zhang, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiang Bai

GSDrive: Reinforcing Driving Policies by Multi-mode Trajectory Probing with 3D Gaussian Splatting Environment AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving 3D Gaussian Splatting reinforcement learning trajectory probing differentiable simulation

简要说明：GSDrive利用3D高斯泼溅进行可微分的、基于物理的奖励塑造和多模态轨迹探测，以改进端到端自动驾驶策略，在闭环实验中超越了现有的基于模拟的强化学习方法。

TLDR: GSDrive improves end-to-end autonomous driving policies by using 3D Gaussian Splatting for differentiable physics-based reward shaping and multi-mode trajectory probing, outperforming prior simulation-based RL methods.

Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving presents a promising approach for translating perceptual inputs directly into driving actions. However, prohibitive annotation costs and temporal data quality degradation hinder long-term real-world deployment. While combining imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) is a common strategy for policy improvement, conventional RL training relies on delayed, event-based rewards-policies learn only from catastrophic outcomes such as collisions, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal behaviors. To address these limitations, we introduce GSDrive, a framework that exploits 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for differentiable, physics-based reward shaping in E2E driving policy improvement. Our method incorporates a flow matching-based trajectory predictor within the 3DGS simulator, enabling multi-mode trajectory probing where candidate trajectories are rolled out to assess prospective rewards. This establishes a bidirectional knowledge exchange between IL and RL by grounding reward functions in physically simulated interaction signals, offering immediate dense feedback instead of sparse catastrophic events. Evaluated on the reconstructed nuScenes dataset, our method surpasses existing simulation-based RL driving approaches in closed-loop experiments. Code is available at https://github.com/ZionGo6/GSDrive.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶技术展现出将感知输入直接转化为驾驶行为的广阔前景，但高昂的标注成本与随时间推移产生的数据质量退化阻碍了其在真实世界的长期部署。尽管结合模仿学习与强化学习是策略优化的常用方法，但传统强化学习训练依赖于延迟的、基于事件的奖励机制——策略仅能从碰撞等灾难性后果中学习，导致过早收敛至次优行为。为解决这些局限，我们提出GSDrive框架，该框架利用3D高斯溅射技术在端到端驾驶策略优化中实现可微分的、基于物理的奖励塑形。我们的方法在3DGS模拟器中整合了基于流匹配的轨迹预测器，支持多模态轨迹探索——通过推演候选轨迹以评估预期奖励。该方法通过将奖励函数锚定于物理模拟的交互信号，在模仿学习与强化学习之间构建了双向知识交换，提供即时密集反馈而非稀疏的灾难性事件反馈。基于重构nuScenes数据集的评估表明，我们的方法在闭环实验中超越了现有基于模拟的强化学习驾驶方案。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZionGo6/GSDrive。

Authors: Ziang Guo, Min Chen, Xuefeng Zhang, Yixiao Zhou, Zufeng Zhang, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

MotuBrain: An Advanced World Action Model for Robot Control WorldModel

World Action Model VLA Unified Multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers Real-time Inference

简要说明：MotuBrain是一个用于机器人控制的统一多模态生成式世界行动模型，支持策略学习、世界建模和视频生成，并具备高效的实时部署能力。

TLDR: MotuBrain is a unified multimodal generative world action model for robot control that supports policy learning, world modeling, and video generation under a single model with efficient real-time deployment.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong semantic generalization but often lack fine-grained modeling of world dynamics. Recent work explores video generation models as a foundation for world modeling, leading to unified World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly model visual dynamics and actions. We present MotuBrain, a unified multimodal generative model that jointly models video and action under a UniDiffuser formulation with a three-stream Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. A single model supports multiple inference modes, including policy learning, world modeling, video generation, inverse dynamics, and joint video-action prediction, while scaling to heterogeneous multimodal data such as video-only and cross-embodiment robot data. To improve real-world applicability, MotuBrain introduces a unified multiview representation, explicit language-action coupling, and an efficient inference stack, achieving over 50x speedup for real-time deployment.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 视觉-语言-行为（VLA）模型在语义泛化方面表现出色，但通常对世界动态的细粒度建模能力不足。近期研究探索将视频生成模型作为世界建模的基础，从而催生了能够统一建模视觉动态与行为的“世界行动模型”（WAMs）。本文提出MotuBrain——一个统一的多模态生成模型，它基于UniDiffuser架构，采用三流混合变换器结构，实现了对视频与行为的联合建模。该模型支持多种推理模式，包括策略学习、世界建模、视频生成、逆向动力学以及联合视频-行为预测，并能扩展至异构多模态数据（如纯视频数据和跨具身机器人数据）。为提升实际应用能力，MotuBrain引入了统一的多视图表示、显式的语言-行为耦合机制以及高效推理框架，实现了超过50倍的实时部署加速。

Authors: MotuBrain Team, Chendong Xiang, Fan Bao, Haitian Liu, Hengkai Tan, Hongzhe Bi, James Li, Jiabao Liu, Jingrui Pang, Kiro Jing, Louis Liu, Mengchen Cai, Rongxu Cui, Ruowen Zhao, Runqing Wang, Shuhe Huang, Yao Feng, Yinze Rong, Zeyuan Wang, Jun Zhu

PALCAS: A Priority-Aware Intelligent Lane Change Advisory System for Autonomous Vehicles using Federated Reinforcement Learning AutonomousDriving

federated reinforcement learning lane change advisory system multi-agent priority-aware parameterized deep Q-network

简要说明：PALCAS提出了一种基于多智能体联邦强化学习的优先级感知自动驾驶变道咨询系统，通过新颖的奖励函数和参数化DQN提升交通效率与安全。

TLDR: PALCAS introduces a priority-aware lane change advisory system for autonomous vehicles using multi-agent federated reinforcement learning, improving traffic efficiency and safety through a novel reward function and parameterized DQN.

Abstract: We present a priority-aware intelligent lane change advisory system based on multi-agent federated reinforcement learning, namely PALCAS, for autonomous vehicles (AVs). While existing lane-change approaches typically focus on single-agent systems or centralized multi-agent systems, we introduce a federated reinforcement learning-based multi-agent lane change system prioritizing lane changing based on vehicle destination urgency. PALCAS incorporates a novel priority-aware safe lane-change reward function to enable judicious lane-change decisions in both mandatory and discretionary scenarios. PALCAS leverages the parameterized deep Q-network (PDQN) algorithm to facilitate effective cooperation among agents, enabling both lateral and longitudinal motion controls of AVs. Extensive simulations conducted using the SUMO traffic simulator and Mosaic V2X communication framework demonstrate that PALCAS significantly improves traffic efficiency, driving safety, comfort, destination arrival rates, and merging success rates compared to baseline methods.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种基于多智能体联邦强化学习的优先级感知智能换道辅助系统PALCAS，面向自动驾驶车辆设计。现有换道方法通常聚焦于单智能体系统或集中式多智能体系统，本系统创新性地引入基于联邦强化学习的多智能体换道框架，通过车辆目的地紧迫度实现换道优先级动态决策。PALCAS采用新型优先级感知安全换道奖励函数，可在强制性与自主性换道场景中实现精准决策。系统通过参数化深度Q网络（PDQN）算法促进智能体间协同合作，同时支持自动驾驶车辆的横向与纵向运动控制。基于SUMO交通仿真器与Mosaic V2X通信框架的大规模实验表明，相较于基准方法，PALCAS在交通效率、行驶安全性、乘坐舒适度、目的地抵达率及合流成功率等关键指标上均有显著提升。

Authors: Yassine Ibork, Nhat Ha Nguyen, Myounggyu Won, Lokesh Das

Understanding Adversarial Transferability in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving: A Cross-Architecture Analysis AutonomousDriving

adversarial transferability vision-language models autonomous driving physical adversarial patches cross-architecture analysis

简要说明：针对自动驾驶中视觉语言模型，对物理可实现的对抗性补丁进行了系统的跨架构可迁移性分析，证明了高迁移率。

TLDR: Systematic cross-architecture analysis of adversarial transferability for physically realizable patches targeting vision-language models in autonomous driving scenarios, demonstrating high transfer rates.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in autonomous driving because they combine visual perception with language-based reasoning, supporting more interpretable decision-making, yet their robustness to physical adversarial attacks, especially whether such attacks transfer across different VLM architectures, is not well understood and poses a practical risk when attackers do not know which model a vehicle uses. We address this gap with a systematic cross-architecture study of adversarial transferability in VLM-based driving, evaluating three representative architectures (Dolphins, OmniDrive, and LeapVAD) using physically realizable patches placed on roadside infrastructure in both crosswalk and highway scenarios. Our transfer-matrix evaluation shows high cross-architecture effectiveness, with transfer rates of 73-91% (mean TR = 0.815 for crosswalk and 0.833 for highway) and sustained frame-level manipulation over 64.7-79.4% of the critical decision window even when patches are not optimized for the target model.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型在自动驾驶领域的应用日益广泛，其通过融合视觉感知与语言推理能力，能够提供更具可解释性的决策支持。然而，此类模型对于物理对抗攻击的鲁棒性尚未得到充分认知，尤其是攻击在不同模型架构间的可迁移性尚不明确，这在实际场景中构成了显著风险：当攻击者无法预知目标车辆所采用的具体模型时，攻击可能仍具有广泛适用性。本文针对这一研究空白，系统性地探究了基于视觉-语言模型的自动驾驶系统中对抗样本的跨架构迁移特性。我们在人行横道和高速公路两种场景下，将物理可实现的对抗性贴片布设在路侧基础设施上，对三种代表性架构模型（Dolphins、OmniDrive和LeapVAD）进行了评估。通过迁移矩阵分析，我们发现攻击具有较高的跨架构有效性：迁移率达到73-91%（人行横道场景平均迁移率TR=0.815，高速公路场景平均TR=0.833），且即使贴片未针对目标模型进行优化，仍能在关键决策窗口64.7-79.4%的帧序列中持续产生误导效果。

Authors: David Fernandez, Pedram MohajerAnsari, Amir Salarpour, Mert D. Pese

Judge, Then Drive: A Critic-Centric Vision Language Action Framework for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision Language Action Autonomous Driving Critic Closed-loop Trajectory Refinement

简要说明：提出了一种用于自动驾驶的批评者中心视觉语言行动框架，该框架利用VLA先生成粗略轨迹，再通过多模态评估和单步优化进行细化，在大型合成数据集上验证，并在闭环驾驶基准测试中表现出性能提升。

TLDR: Presents a critic-centric vision-language-action framework for autonomous driving that uses a VLA to first generate a rough trajectory and then refine it through multimodal evaluation and optimization, demonstrated on a large synthetic dataset and showing improved performance in closed-loop driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Recent advances in vision language action (VLA) models have shown remarkable potential for autonomous driving by directly mapping multimodal inputs to control signals. However, previous VLA-based methods have not explicitly exploited the critic capability of VLAs to refine driving decisions, even though such capability has been well demonstrated in other LLM-based domains, thereby limiting their performance in complex closed-loop scenarios. In this work, we present a theoretically inspired two-stage framework, CriticVLA, which extends the role of VLAs from acting to judging. CriticVLA first generates a rough trajectory and then refines it through multimodal evaluation and single-step optimization guided by a VLA-based critic, yielding higher-quality driving behaviors. To support this process, we construct a large-scale synthetic dataset of 12.9 million annotated trajectories covering diverse driving scenarios, which enhances the critic's reasoning and refinement abilities. Extensive closed-loop experiments on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that CriticVLA significantly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 73.33% total success rate and delivering about 30% improvement in challenging scenarios.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言动作模型在自动驾驶领域的最新进展显示，通过直接映射多模态输入到控制信号展现出巨大潜力。然而，先前基于VLA的方法未能充分利用VLA的评判能力来优化驾驶决策，尽管这种能力在其他基于大语言模型的领域已得到充分验证，这限制了其在复杂闭环场景中的性能。本研究提出了一个理论启发的两阶段框架——CriticVLA，将VLA的角色从执行扩展到评判。该框架首先生成粗略轨迹，随后通过基于VLA评判器的多模态评估与单步优化进行精细化处理，从而生成更高质量的驾驶行为。为支持该流程，我们构建了包含1290万条标注轨迹的大规模合成数据集，涵盖多样化的驾驶场景，以增强评判器的推理与优化能力。在Bench2Drive基准测试上的大量闭环实验表明，CriticVLA显著超越现有最优基线方法，实现了73.33%的总成功率，并在挑战性场景中取得约30%的性能提升。

Authors: Lijin Yang, Jianing Huang, Zhongzhan Huang, Shu Liu, Hao Yang

Dreaming Across Towns: Semantic Rollout and Town-Adversarial Regularization for Zero-Shot Held-Out-Town Fixed-Route Driving in CARLA AutonomousDriving

World Models Zero-Shot Transfer Adversarial Regularization Semantic Rollout CARLA

简要说明：该论文提出了一种基于Dreamer的驾驶智能体，结合语义推演预测和城镇对抗正则化，以提升在CARLA模拟器中固定路线上未见城镇的零样本迁移性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes a Dreamer-based driving agent with semantic rollout prediction and town-adversarial regularization to improve zero-shot transfer in fixed-route CARLA driving across unseen towns.

Abstract: Learned driving agents often degrade when deployed in unseen environments. This paper studies a deliberately bounded instance of that problem in the CARLA simulator: zero-shot transfer of a closed-loop fixed-route driving agent from Town05 and Town06 to unseen Town03 and Town04. The study isolates structural town shift by keeping weather fixed to ClearNoon and removing traffic and pedestrians. We build on a Dreamer-style latent world-model agent and add two training-only auxiliary losses: multi-horizon prediction of future visual-semantic embeddings along imagined rollouts and town-adversarial supervision on a semantic projection of the recurrent latent state. A causal context feature conditions the semantic rollout predictor, while the actor and critic retain the standard control feature. The policy receives no navigation command, route polyline, goal pose, or map input; the reference route is used only by the environment for reward, progress, success, and termination. Across the evaluated held-out towns, the proposed model achieves the highest mean success rate among the included Dreamer-family methods. Secondary safety and lane-keeping metrics are mixed across towns. These results support a bounded conclusion: in this controlled fixed-weather CARLA setting, semantic rollout supervision combined with town-adversarial regularization improves mean held-out-town route completion.

摘要（中文）：已训练驾驶智能体在未知环境中部署时常出现性能下降。本文研究该问题在CARLA仿真器中严格限定的实例：封闭环境下固定路线的驾驶智能体从未经训练的Town05和Town06到未知Town03和Town04的零样本迁移。研究通过将天气固定为ClearNoon并移除交通流与行人，以分离城镇结构变化的影响。我们在Dreamer式潜在世界模型智能体的基础上，新增两项仅训练时使用的辅助损失：沿想象推演轨迹对视觉语义嵌入进行多时序预测，以及对循环潜在状态的语义投影施加城镇对抗性监督。因果上下文特征作为语义轨迹预测器的条件，而执行器与评价器仍保留标准控制特征。策略网络不接收导航指令、路线折线、目标位姿或地图输入；参考路线仅被环境用于计算奖励、进度、成功率及终止条件。在评估的保留城镇中，所提模型在Dreamer系列方法中实现了最高平均成功率。次级安全性与车道保持指标在不同城镇间表现存在差异。这些结果支持一个有限定结论：在此受控的固定天气CARLA场景中，语义轨迹监督与城镇对抗正则化相结合能提升平均保留城镇路线完成率。

Authors: Feeza Khan Khanzada, Jaerock Kwon

Connected Dependability Cage: Run-Time Function and Anomaly Monitoring for the Development and Operation of Safe Automated Vehicles AutonomousDriving

safety monitoring fail-operational perception systems anomaly detection automated vehicles

简要说明：提出了一个连接可靠性框架，集成了功能和异常监控器，用于在自动驾驶车辆的AI感知系统中实现分层故障可运行安全。

TLDR: Proposes a Connected Dependability Cage architecture with function and anomaly monitors to enable hierarchical fail-operational safety for AI perception systems in automated vehicles.

Abstract: The advancement of automated vehicles introduces complex safety challenges, particularly in dynamic and unpredictable environments where AI-enabled perception systems must operate reliably. Ensuring compliance with safety standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF) is essential for addressing system malfunctions and mitigating unsafe behavior in unknown scenarios. However, as automation levels increase, vehicles must go beyond conventional functional safety by incorporating fail-operational capabilities that enable continued safe operation during system or component failures and the handling of unfamiliar or degraded operational conditions. To address these safety concerns, we propose the Connected Dependability Cage, an architectural framework designed to enable hierarchical fail-operational behavior in AI-enabled perception systems. This framework integrates two complementary monitoring mechanisms: a Function Monitor that oversees multiple heterogeneous AI-based perception pipelines and detects inconsistencies through a voting mechanism, and an Anomaly Monitor that evaluates the reliability of AI perception by detecting unknown or novel objects in scenes that may be excluded from the training dataset. In the presence of critical discrepancies, the system supports graceful degradation, ultimately enabling a transition to a minimal-risk maneuver strategy. Furthermore, whenever either monitor raises a safety flag, an automated data recording process is initiated to facilitate iterative system development and continuous improvement. Both monitors have been implemented and validated through extensive vehicle testing, demonstrating their practical effectiveness in real-world applications.

摘要（中文）：自动车辆的进步带来了复杂的安全挑战，尤其是在动态且不可预测的环境中，人工智能感知系统必须在此类环境中可靠运行。确保符合ISO 26262和ISO/PAS 21448（SOTIF）等安全标准对于解决系统故障和减轻未知场景中的不安全行为至关重要。然而，随着自动化水平的提升，车辆必须超越传统的功能安全，通过引入失效可操作性能力来确保在系统或组件故障期间能够持续安全运行，并处理不熟悉或性能下降的操作条件。针对这些安全挑战，我们提出了"连接式可靠性防护框架"——一种架构设计，旨在使人工智能感知系统具备分层失效可操作性。该框架整合了两种互补的监控机制：功能监控器通过投票机制监督多个异构的基于人工智能的感知流程并检测不一致性，以及异常监控器通过检测训练数据集中可能遗漏的未知或新型物体来评估人工智能感知的可靠性。当出现关键差异时，系统支持平稳降级，最终过渡至最小风险操作策略。此外，当任一监控器触发安全警示时，系统会自动启动数据记录流程，以促进迭代式系统开发和持续改进。两种监控机制均已通过广泛的车辆测试实施和验证，展示了其在真实场景中的实际有效性。

Authors: Iqra Aslam, Nour Habib, Abhishek Buragohain, Meng Zhang, Andreas Rausch, Vaibhav Tiwari, Mohamed Benchat

ExoActor: Exocentric Video Generation as Generalizable Interactive Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid control video generation interaction modeling motion estimation generalizable behavior

简要说明：ExoActor利用以第三人称视角的视频生成作为统一接口来建模人形机器人与环境的交互动力学，生成的视频通过运动估计和控制器转化为可执行的行为序列，并推广到新场景。

TLDR: ExoActor uses exocentric video generation to model humanoid-environment interactions, producing videos that are then transformed into executable humanoid control sequences for novel tasks.

Abstract: Humanoid control systems have made significant progress in recent years, yet modeling fluent interaction-rich behavior between a robot, its surrounding environment, and task-relevant objects remains a fundamental challenge. This difficulty arises from the need to jointly capture spatial context, temporal dynamics, robot actions, and task intent at scale, which is a poor match to conventional supervision. We propose ExoActor, a novel framework that leverages the generalization capabilities of large-scale video generation models to address this problem. The key insight in ExoActor is to use third-person video generation as a unified interface for modeling interaction dynamics. Given a task instruction and scene context, ExoActor synthesizes plausible execution processes that implicitly encode coordinated interactions between robot, environment, and objects. Such video output is then transformed into executable humanoid behaviors through a pipeline that estimates human motion and executes it via a general motion controller, yielding a task-conditioned behavior sequence. To validate the proposed framework, we implement it as an end-to-end system and demonstrate its generalization to new scenarios without additional real-world data collection. Furthermore, we conclude by discussing limitations of the current implementation and outlining promising directions for future research, illustrating how ExoActor provides a scalable approach to modeling interaction-rich humanoid behaviors, potentially opening a new avenue for generative models to advance general-purpose humanoid intelligence.

摘要（中文）：近年来，人形机器人控制系统已取得重大进展，但如何对机器人、周围环境以及任务相关物体之间流畅且富含交互的行为进行建模，仍然是一个基础性挑战。这一困难源于需要在大规模尺度上同时捕捉空间情境、时间动态、机器人动作和任务意图，而传统监督方法难以适应这一需求。为此，我们提出ExoActor——一种新型框架，它利用大规模视频生成模型的泛化能力来解决这一问题。ExoActor的核心思路是将第三人称视角的视频生成作为建模交互动态的统一接口。给定任务指令与场景情境，ExoActor能够合成隐含编码机器人、环境及物体间协同交互的合理执行过程。生成的视频输出随后通过一个估计人体运动并通过通用运动控制器执行的流程，转化为可执行的人形机器人行为，从而生成任务条件化的行为序列。为验证该框架，我们构建了一个端到端系统，并展示了其在无需额外真实数据收集的情况下对新场景的泛化能力。最后，我们讨论了当前实现的局限性，并展望了未来研究的潜在方向，阐述了ExoActor如何为建模富含交互的人形机器人行为提供可扩展的途径，可能为生成式模型推动通用人形机器人智能开辟新路径。

Authors: Yanghao Zhou, Jingyu Ma, Yibo Peng, Zhenguo Sun, Yu Bai, Börje F. Karlsson

RAY-TOLD: Ray-Based Latent Dynamics for Dense Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance with TDMPC RLRobot

dynamic obstacle avoidance latent dynamics model MPPI control reinforcement learning policy prior

简要说明：提出了一种混合控制架构，结合了基于LiDAR的潜在动力学模型与MPPI，利用学习到的策略先验和终端价值函数，以改善在密集动态人群中的导航性能。

TLDR: Proposes a hybrid control architecture combining a LiDAR-centric latent dynamics model with MPPI, using a learned policy prior and terminal value function to improve navigation in dense dynamic crowds.

Abstract: Dense, dynamic crowds pose a persistent challenge for autonomous mobile robots. Purely reactive planning methods, such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, often fail to escape local minima in complex scenarios due to their limited prediction horizon. To bridge this gap, we propose Ray-based Task-Oriented Latent Dynamics (RAY-TOLD), a hybrid control architecture that integrates obstacle information into latent dynamics and utilizes the robustness of physics-based MPPI with the long-horizon foresight of reinforcement learning. RAY-TOLD leverages a LiDAR-centric latent dynamics model to encode high-dimensional sensor data into a compact state representation, enabling the learning of a terminal value function and a policy prior. We introduce a policy mixture sampling strategy that augments the MPPI candidate population with trajectories derived from the learned policy, effectively guiding the planner towards the goal while maintaining kinematic feasibility. Extensive tests in a stochastic environment with high-density dynamic obstacles demonstrate that our method outperforms the MPPI baseline, reducing the collision rate. The results confirm that blending short-horizon physics-based rollouts with learned long-horizon intent significantly enhances navigation reliability and safety.

摘要（中文）：密集动态人群对自主移动机器人构成持续挑战。纯反应式规划方法（如模型预测路径积分控制）因预测视野有限，在复杂场景中常陷入局部最优解。为弥补这一缺陷，我们提出基于射线的任务导向潜在动态模型（RAY-TOLD）——一种混合控制架构，将障碍物信息整合至潜在动态系统，并融合基于物理的模型预测路径积分控制的鲁棒性与强化学习的长远预见能力。该模型通过以激光雷达为核心的潜在动态编码器，将高维传感器数据压缩为紧凑状态表征，从而支持终端价值函数与策略先验的学习。我们引入策略混合采样策略，通过将学习策略生成的轨迹与模型预测路径积分候选轨迹集融合，在保持运动学可行性的同时有效引导规划器朝向目标。在高密度动态障碍物的随机环境中进行的广泛测试表明，本方法优于模型预测路径积分基准，显著降低了碰撞率。实验结果证实，融合短期基于物理的推演与学习获得的长期意图，能显著提升导航的可靠性与安全性。

Authors: Seungho Han, Seokju Lee, Jeonguk Kang

DOT-Sim: Differentiable Optical Tactile Simulation with Precise Real-to-Sim Physical Calibration Manipulation

tactile simulation differentiable simulation sim-to-real optical tactile sensor Material Point Method

简要说明：该论文提出了DOT-Sim，一种用于光学触觉传感器的可微分模拟器，使用MPM进行物理建模和残差图像方法进行光学模拟，实现了快速校准和面向接触丰富任务的模拟到现实迁移。

TLDR: The paper proposes DOT-Sim, a differentiable simulator for optical tactile sensors that uses MPM for physics and a residual image approach for optics, enabling fast calibration and sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Simulating optical tactile sensors presents significant challenges due to their high deformability and intricate optical properties. To address these issues and enable a physically accurate simulation, we propose DOT-Sim: Differentiable Optical Tactile Simulation. Unlike prior simulators that rely on simplified models of deformable sensors, DOT-Sim accurately captures the physical behavior of soft sensors by modeling them as elastic materials using the Material Point Method (MPM). DOT-Sim enables rapid calibration of optical tactile sensor simulation using a small number of demonstrations within minutes, which is substantially faster than existing methods. Compared to current baselines, our approach supports much larger and non-linear deformations. To handle the optical aspect, we propose a novel approach to simulating optical responses by learning a residual image relative to the real-world idle state. We validate the physical and visual realism of our method through a series of zero-shot sim-to-real tasks. Our experiments show that DOT-Sim (1) accurately replicates the physical dynamics of a DenseTact optical tactile sensor in reality, (2) generates realistic optical outputs in contact-rich scenarios, (3) enables direct deployment of simulation-trained classifiers in the real world, achieving 85% classification accuracy on challenging objects and 90% accuracy in embedded tumor-type detection, and (4) allows precise trajectory following with a policy trained from demonstrations in simulation, with an average error of less than 0.9 mm.

摘要（中文）：模拟光学触觉传感器因其高可变形性和复杂的光学特性而面临巨大挑战。为解决这些问题并实现物理精确的模拟，我们提出了DOT-Sim：可微分光学触觉模拟系统。与以往依赖简化可变形传感器模型的模拟器不同，DOT-Sim通过材料点法将柔性传感器建模为弹性材料，从而准确捕捉其物理行为。该系统能在数分钟内利用少量演示数据快速完成光学触觉传感器模拟的校准，速度显著优于现有方法。与当前基准相比，我们的方法支持更大范围和非线性变形。针对光学特性，我们提出了一种创新方法，通过相对于真实世界静止状态学习残差图像来模拟光学响应。我们通过一系列零样本模拟到真实任务验证了方法的物理与视觉真实性。实验表明，DOT-Sim能够：（1）精确复现DenseTact光学触觉传感器在现实中的物理动态，（2）在密集接触场景中生成逼真的光学输出，（3）支持仿真训练的分类器在真实世界中直接部署，在复杂物体上实现85%的分类准确率，在嵌入式肿瘤检测中达到90%的准确率，（4）通过仿真演示训练的策略实现精确轨迹跟随，平均误差小于0.9毫米。

Authors: Yang You, Won Kyung Do, Aiden Swann, Rika Antonova, Monroe Kennedy, Leonidas Guibas

Real-Time GPU-Accelerated Monte Carlo Evaluation of Safety-Critical AEB Systems Under Uncertainty AutonomousDriving

Monte Carlo GPU-accelerated Automatic Emergency Braking real-time evaluation safety-critical

简要说明：本文提出一个GPU加速的蒙特卡洛框架，用于在不确定性下对自动紧急制动（AEB）系统性能进行实时随机评估，从而实现风险感知的阈值选择，并可作为运行时组件部署。

TLDR: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo framework for real-time, stochastic evaluation of Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) system performance under uncertainty, enabling risk-aware threshold selection and deployment as a runtime component.

Abstract: Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) systems represent a safety-critical national interest, with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS No. 127) requiring AEB in all new light vehicles sold in the United States by September 2029. However, production implementations frequently rely on deterministic stopping-distance or Time-to-Collision (TTC) thresholds that fail to capture uncertainty in sensing, road conditions, and vehicle dynamics. This paper presents a GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo framework for stochastic evaluation of emergency braking performance using a high-fidelity longitudinal vehicle model incorporating aerodynamic drag, road grade, brake actuator dynamics, and weight transfer effects. A one-thread-per-sample execution strategy exploits the independence of Monte Carlo rollouts, while deterministic CPU-generated sampling ensures bit-exact numerical consistency between CPU and GPU implementations. The framework is evaluated across four hardware platforms spanning development and deployment environments: two laptop GPUs (GTX 1650, RTX 5070) and two automotive-grade embedded platforms (Jetson Orin Nano, Jetson AGX Orin). Peak speedups of 54.57x are achieved while maintaining exact numerical agreement. Real-time feasibility analysis with a complete AEB timing budget (700 ms human reaction time minus 120 ms perception and 50 ms decision overhead) demonstrates that the Jetson AGX Orin can execute approximately 25,000 Monte Carlo samples within a 530 ms budget, enabling real-time probabilistic AEB evaluation as part of a complete embedded pipeline. These results establish Monte Carlo-based uncertainty evaluation as a deployable runtime component rather than an offline validation tool and provide quantitative guidance for risk-aware AEB threshold selection under the NHTSA final rule.

摘要（中文）：自动紧急制动（AEB）系统作为关乎国家利益的安全关键系统，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）在《联邦机动车安全标准》（FMVSS第127号）中要求，到2029年9月所有在美国销售的新型轻型车辆都必须配备AEB。然而，现有量产系统通常采用基于确定性的制动距离或碰撞时间（TTC）阈值策略，这些策略难以有效捕捉感知、路况及车辆动力学中的不确定性。本文提出了一种基于GPU加速的蒙特卡洛框架，用于随机评估紧急制动性能。该框架采用高保真纵向车辆模型，综合考虑了空气阻力、道路坡度、制动执行器动力学及重量转移效应。通过“每样本单线程”的执行策略，充分利用蒙特卡洛模拟的独立性；同时采用确定性CPU生成采样，确保CPU与GPU实现之间的数值精确一致性。研究在涵盖开发与部署环境的四种硬件平台上进行评估：两款笔记本电脑GPU（GTX 1650和RTX 5070）以及两款汽车级嵌入式平台（Jetson Orin Nano和Jetson AGX Orin）。在保持完全数值一致性的前提下，最高实现了54.57倍的加速比。基于完整AEB时序预算（700毫秒人类反应时间减去120毫秒感知时间与50毫秒决策开销）的实时可行性分析表明，Jetson AGX Orin平台可在530毫秒的预算内执行约25,000次蒙特卡洛样本，从而使得基于概率的实时AEB评估能够作为完整嵌入式流程的一部分运行。这些成果确立了基于蒙特卡洛的不确定性评估方法可作为可部署的运行时组件而非离线验证工具，并为NHTSA最终规则下的风险感知型AEB阈值选择提供了量化指导。

Authors: Akshay Karjol, Shadi Alawneh

Global Sampling-Based Trajectory Optimization for Contact-Rich Manipulation via KernelSOS Manipulation

trajectory optimization contact-rich manipulation sampling-based methods kernel sum-of-squares global exploration

简要说明：提出Global-MPPI，一种结合全局核平方和优化与局部MPPI细化的统一轨迹优化框架，用于接触丰富的操作任务。

TLDR: Proposes Global-MPPI, a unified trajectory optimization framework combining global kernel sum-of-squares optimization with local MPPI refinement for contact-rich manipulation.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation is challenging due to its high dimensionality, the requirement for long time horizons, and the presence of hybrid contact dynamics. Sampling-based methods have become a popular approach for this class of problems, but without explicit mechanisms for global exploration, they are susceptible to converging to poor local minima. In this paper, we introduce Global-MPPI, a unified trajectory optimization framework that integrates global exploration and local refinement. At the global level, we leverage kernel sum-of-squares optimization to identify globally promising regions of the solution space. To enable reliable performance for the non-smooth landscapes inherent to contact-rich manipulation, we introduce a graduated non-convexity strategy based on log-sum-exp smoothing, which transitions the optimization landscape from a smoothed surrogate to the original non-smooth objective. Finally, we employ the model-predictive path integral method to locally refine the solution. We evaluate Global-MPPI on high-dimensional, long-horizon contact-rich tasks, including the PushT task and dexterous in-hand manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach robustly uncovers high-quality solutions, achieving faster convergence and lower final costs compared to existing baseline methods.

摘要（中文）：接触式操控因其高维度、长时域要求以及混合接触动力学的存在而具有挑战性。基于采样的方法已成为处理此类问题的常用手段，但若无明确的全局探索机制，它们容易收敛至较差的局部极小值。本文提出Global-MPPI这一融合全局探索与局部优化的统一轨迹优化框架。在全局层面，我们借助核平方和优化方法识别解空间中具有全局潜力的区域。针对接触式操控固有的非光滑优化场景，我们引入基于对数求和指数平滑的逐级非凸优化策略，使优化过程从平滑的代理模型逐步过渡至原始的非光滑目标函数。最后，我们采用模型预测路径积分方法对解进行局部优化。我们在高维度、长时程的接触式操控任务（包括PushT任务和灵巧手内操作）上对Global-MPPI进行评估。实验结果表明，相较于现有基准方法，我们的方法能稳健地寻得高质量解，在收敛速度与最终成本方面均表现出更优性能。

Authors: Zhongqi Wei, Frederike Dümbgen

SpaAct: Spatially-Activated Transition Learning with Curriculum Adaptation for Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation spatial activation curriculum learning VLM adaptation transition prediction

简要说明：SpaAct 通过引入反向动作推理和向前转移预测的空间激活任务，以及课程学习方法，增强基于 VLM 的导航能力。

TLDR: SpaAct enhances VLM-based navigation by adding spatial activation tasks for backward action reasoning and forward transition prediction, and a curriculum learning method to stabilize training.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions and navigate to a target location in unseen 3D environments. We argue that adapting VLMs to VLN requires endowing them with two complementary capabilities for acquiring such awareness, namely backward action reasoning (why) and forward transition prediction~(how). Based on this insight, we propose SpaAct, a simple yet effective training framework that activates the dynamic spatial awareness in VLMs. Specifically, SpaAct introduces two spatial activation tasks: Action Retrospection, which asks the model to infer the executed action sequence from visual transitions, and Future Frame Selection, which forces the model to predict the visual transitions conditioned on history and action. These two objectives provide lightweight supervision on both backward action reasoning and forward transition prediction, encouraging the model to build dynamic spatial awareness in a VLM-friendly way. To further stabilize adaptation, we design TriPA, a Tri-factor Progressive Adaptive curriculum learning method that organizes training samples from easy to hard, allowing the model to gradually acquire navigation skills from basic locomotion to long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks show that SpaAct consistently improves VLM-based navigation and achieves state-of-the-art performance. We will release the code and models to support future research.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航旨在使具身智能体能够根据自然语言指令在未知的三维环境中导航至目标位置。我们认为，将视觉语言模型应用于导航任务需要赋予其两种互补的认知能力：逆向动作推理（为何行动）与正向状态预测（如何行动）。基于此洞察，我们提出SpaAct——一种简单高效的训练框架，旨在激活视觉语言模型中的动态空间感知能力。具体而言，SpaAct设计了两个空间激活任务：动作回溯要求模型通过视觉状态变化推断已执行的动作序列，未来帧选择则强制模型基于历史轨迹和动作指令预测视觉状态变化。这两个目标通过轻量级监督同时强化逆向动作推理与正向状态预测能力，促使模型以适配视觉语言模型的方式构建动态空间认知。为进一步提升训练稳定性，我们设计了TriPA三因子渐进式课程学习方法，通过由易到难组织训练样本，使模型从基础运动能力逐步进阶至长时序推理。在标准VLN-CE基准测试上的实验表明，SpaAct能持续提升基于视觉语言模型的导航性能，并达到当前最优水平。我们将公开代码与模型以支持后续研究。

Authors: Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Lin Zhao, Kailin Lyu, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Nanning Zheng

World2Minecraft: Occupancy-Driven Simulated Scenes Construction VLN

3D semantic occupancy Minecraft reconstruction Vision-Language Navigation data acquisition pipeline embodied AI simulation

简要说明：World2Minecraft提出了一条通过3D语义占据预测将真实世界场景转化为结构化《我的世界》环境的流程，以支持下游具身智能任务如视觉语言导航。它还引入了数据采集流程来创建大规模占据数据集MinecraftOcc，以改进预测模型。

TLDR: World2Minecraft is a pipeline for converting real-world scenes into structured Minecraft environments via 3D semantic occupancy prediction, enabling downstream embodied AI tasks like Vision-Language Navigation. It also introduces a data pipeline to create a large-scale occupancy dataset, MinecraftOcc, to improve prediction models.

Abstract: Embodied intelligence requires high-fidelity simulation environments to support perception and decision-making, yet existing platforms often suffer from data contamination and limited flexibility. To mitigate this, we propose World2Minecraft to convert real-world scenes into structured Minecraft environments based on 3D semantic occupancy prediction. In the reconstructed scenes, we can effortlessly perform downstream tasks such as Vision-Language Navigation(VLN). However, we observe that reconstruction quality heavily depends on accurate occupancy prediction, which remains limited by data scarcity and poor generalization in existing models. We introduce a low-cost, automated, and scalable data acquisition pipeline for creating customized occupancy datasets, and demonstrate its effectiveness through MinecraftOcc, a large-scale dataset featuring 100,165 images from 156 richly detailed indoor scenes. Extensive experiments show that our dataset provides a critical complement to existing datasets and poses a significant challenge to current SOTA methods. These findings contribute to improving occupancy prediction and highlight the value of World2Minecraft in providing a customizable and editable platform for personalized embodied AI research. Project page:https://world2minecraft.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：具身体智能需要高保真度的仿真环境来支持感知与决策，但现有平台常受数据污染和灵活性不足的限制。为此，我们提出World2Minecraft，基于3D语义占据预测将真实世界场景转换为结构化Minecraft环境。在重建场景中，我们能够无缝执行视觉语言导航等下游任务。然而，我们发现重建质量高度依赖于准确的占据预测，而现有模型因数据稀缺和泛化能力不足而受限。我们引入了一种低成本、自动化、可扩展的数据采集流程，用于创建定制的占据数据集，并通过MinecraftOcc数据集验证其有效性——该大规模数据集包含156个细节丰富的室内场景中的100,165张图像。大量实验表明，我们的数据集为现有数据集提供了关键补充，并对当前前沿方法构成显著挑战。这些发现有助于改进占据预测，并凸显了World2Minecraft在提供可定制、可编辑的个性化具身AI研究平台方面的价值。项目页面：https://world2minecraft.github.io/。

Authors: Lechao Zhang, Haoran Xu, Jingyu Gong, Xuhong Wang, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

OmniRobotHome: A Multi-Camera Platform for Real-Time Multiadic Human-Robot Interaction Manipulation

multi-camera platform real-time 3D tracking multi-robot collaboration human-robot interaction occlusion-robust perception

简要说明：OmniRobotHome是一个多摄像头、房间规模平台，用于实时三维跟踪多人和物体，以实现家庭环境中安全、具有预见性的多机器人协作。

TLDR: OmniRobotHome is a multi-camera, room-scale platform enabling real-time 3D tracking of multiple humans and objects for safe, anticipatory multi-robot collaboration in a home environment.

Abstract: Human-robot collaboration has been studied primarily in dyadic or sequential settings. However, real homes require multiadic collaboration, where multiple humans and robots share a workspace, acting concurrently on interleaved subtasks with tight spatial and temporal coupling. This regime remains underexplored because close-proximity interaction between humans, robots, and objects creates persistent occlusion and rapid state changes, making reliable real-time 3D tracking the central bottleneck. No existing platform provides the real-time, occlusion-robust, room-scale perception needed to make this regime experimentally tractable. We present OmniRobotHome, the first room-scale residential platform that unifies wide-area real-time 3D human and object perception with coordinated multi-robot actuation in a shared world frame. The system instruments a natural home environment with 48 hardware-synchronized RGB cameras for markerless, occlusion-robust tracking of multiple humans and objects, temporally aligned with two Franka arms that act on live scene state. Continuous capture within this consistent frame further supports long-horizon human behavior modeling from accumulated trajectories. The platform makes the multiadic collaboration regime experimentally tractable. We focus on two central problems: safety in shared human-robot environments and human-anticipatory robotic assistance, and show that real-time perception and accumulated behavior memory each yield measurable gains in both.

摘要（中文）：人机协作的研究主要集中在二元或顺序场景中。然而真实家庭环境需要多元协作，即多人与多机器人共享工作空间，在时空紧密耦合的交叉子任务中并发行动。这一领域仍待深入探索，因为人、机器人与物体之间的近距离交互会产生持续遮挡和快速状态变化，使得可靠的实时三维跟踪成为核心瓶颈。现有平台均无法提供实现该领域实验研究所需的实时、抗遮挡、房间尺度感知能力。本文提出OmniRobotHome——首个房间尺度的住宅平台，其在统一的世界坐标系中融合了广域实时三维人机物体感知与多机器人协同执行。该系统在自然家居环境中部署了48台硬件同步的RGB相机，实现了对多人多物体的无标记抗遮挡跟踪，并与两台根据实时场景状态操作的Franka机械臂保持时间同步。在此统一坐标系下的连续采集进一步支持基于累积轨迹的长时程人类行为建模。该平台使多元协作机制具备了实验可操作性。我们聚焦两个核心问题：人机共享环境中的安全性，以及具备人类行为预判能力的机器人辅助，并证明实时感知与累积行为记忆分别在两方面都带来了可量化的性能提升。

Authors: Junyoung Lee, Sookwan Han, Jeonghwan Kim, Inhee Lee, Mingi Choi, Jisoo Kim, Wonjung Woo, Hanbyul Joo

RopeDreamer: A Kinematic Recurrent State Space Model for Dynamics of Flexible Deformable Linear Objects Manipulation

Deformable Linear Objects Recurrent State Space Model Kinematic Chain Quaternions Dynamics Modeling

简要说明：提出了一种结合循环状态空间模型与四元数运动学链表示的潜在动力学模型，用于柔性线性变形物体的鲁棒、长期状态预测，通过物理约束防止自相交和拉伸。

TLDR: Proposes a latent dynamics model combining a Recurrent State Space Model with a Quaternionic Kinematic Chain representation for robust, long-term forecasting of Deformable Linear Object (DLO) states, enforcing physical constraints to prevent self-intersections and stretching.

Abstract: The robotic manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is a fundamental challenge due to the high-dimensional, non-linear dynamics of flexible structures and the complexity of maintaining topological integrity during contact-rich tasks. While recent data-driven methods have utilized Recurrent and Graph Neural Networks for dynamics modeling, they often struggle with self-intersections and non-physical deformations, such as tangling and link stretching. In this paper, we propose a latent dynamics framework that combines a Recurrent State Space Model with a Quaternionic Kinematic Chain representation to enable robust, long-term forecasting of DLO states. By encoding the DLO as a sequence of relative rotations (quaternions) rather than independent Cartesian positions, we inherently constrain the model to a physically valid manifold that preserves link-length constancy. Furthermore, we introduce a dual-decoder architecture that decouples state reconstruction from future-state prediction, forcing the latent space to capture the underlying physics of deformation. We evaluate our approach on a large-scale simulated dataset of complex pick-and-place trajectories involving self-intersections. Our results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves a 40.52% reduction in open-loop prediction error over 50-step horizons compared to the state-of-the-art baseline, while reducing inference time by 31.17%. Our model further maintains superior topological consistency in scenarios with multiple crossings, proving its efficacy as a compositional primitive for long-horizon manipulation planning.

摘要（中文）：可变形线性物体的机器人操作是一项基础性挑战，这源于柔性结构的高维非线性动力学特性，以及在密集接触任务中保持拓扑完整性的复杂性。尽管当前的数据驱动方法已利用循环神经网络和图神经网络进行动力学建模，但它们在处理自相交和非物理形变（如纠缠和连杆拉伸）时仍面临困难。本文提出一种隐式动力学框架，结合循环状态空间模型与四元数运动链表示，以实现对可变形线性物体状态的鲁棒长期预测。通过将可变形线性物体编码为一系列相对旋转（四元数）而非独立的笛卡尔坐标位置，该模型本质上被约束在保持连杆长度恒定的物理有效流形上。此外，我们引入一种双解码器架构，将状态重构与未来状态预测解耦，迫使隐空间捕捉形变的底层物理规律。我们在涉及自相交的复杂抓放轨迹大规模仿真数据集上评估了所提方法。结果表明，与现有先进基线模型相比，该模型在50步长开环预测误差上降低了40.52%，同时推理时间减少了31.17%。在多重交叉场景中，该模型进一步保持了优越的拓扑一致性，证明了其作为长时程操作规划的组合基元的有效性。

Authors: Tim Missal, Lucas Domingues, Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Jan Peters, Paula Dornhofer Paro Costa

FlexiTac: A Low-Cost, Open-Source, Scalable Tactile Sensing Solution for Robotic Systems Manipulation

tactile sensing piezoresistive robotic end-effectors visuo-tactile fusion sim-to-real

简要说明：我们提出了FlexiTac，一种低成本、开源、可扩展的用于机器人末端执行器的触觉传感解决方案，支持用于接触感知决策和技能迁移的现代触觉学习流程。

TLDR: We present FlexiTac, a low-cost, open-source, scalable tactile sensing solution for robotic end-effectors, supporting modern tactile learning pipelines for contact-aware decision making and skill transfer.

Abstract: We present FlexiTac, a low-cost, open-source, and scalable piezoresistive tactile sensing solution designed for robotic end-effectors. FlexiTac is a practical "plug-in" module consisting of (i) thin, flexible tactile sensor pads that provide dense tactile signals and (ii) a compact multi-channel readout board that streams synchronized measurements for real-time control and large-scale data collection. FlexiTac pads adopt a sealed three-layer laminate stack (FPC-Velostat-FPC) with electrode patterns directly integrated into flexible printed circuits, substantially improving fabrication throughput and repeatability while maintaining mechanical compliance for deployment on both rigid and soft grippers. The readout electronics use widely available, low-cost components and stream tactile signals to a host computer at 100 Hz via serial communication. Across multiple configurations, including fingertip pads and larger tactile mats, FlexiTac can be mounted on diverse platforms without major mechanical redesign. We further show that FlexiTac supports modern tactile learning pipelines, including 3D visuo-tactile fusion for contact-aware decision making, cross-embodiment skill transfer, and real-to-sim-to-real fine-tuning with GPU-parallel tactile simulation. Our project page is available at https://flexitac.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍FlexiTac——一种低成本、开源、可扩展的压阻式触觉传感解决方案，专为机器人末端执行器设计。FlexiTac是一个实用的“即插即用”模块，包含（1）提供密集触觉信号的柔性薄型触觉传感器垫，以及（2）紧凑型多通道读取电路板，可实时传输同步测量数据用于实时控制与大规模数据采集。FlexiTac传感垫采用密封的三层叠层结构（FPC-导电泡棉-FPC），电极图案直接集成于柔性印刷电路，在保持机械柔顺性以适应刚性与软体夹爪的同时，显著提升了制造效率与可重复性。该读取电路采用广泛可用的低成本元件，通过串行通信以100Hz频率向主机传输触觉信号。FlexiTac可适配多种配置（包括指尖传感垫与大型触觉阵列），无需重大机械重构即可部署于不同平台。我们进一步证明FlexiTac支持现代触觉学习流程，包括：基于三维视觉-触觉融合的接触感知决策、跨本体技能迁移，以及利用GPU并行触觉仿真实现的“真实-仿真-真实”微调。项目页面详见https://flexitac.github.io/。

Authors: Binghao Huang, Yunzhu Li

FreeOcc: Training-Free Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction Perception3D

training-free open-vocabulary occupancy prediction SLAM 3D Gaussian

简要说明：FreeOcc是一个无需训练的框架，用于从视觉序列中实现开放词汇的占据栅格预测，它无需3D标注、姿态真值或任何学习阶段，即可构建全局一致的3D语义占据地图。

TLDR: FreeOcc is a training-free framework for open-vocabulary occupancy prediction from visual sequences, which builds a globally consistent 3D semantic occupancy map without 3D annotations, pose ground truth, or any learning.

Abstract: Existing learning-based occupancy prediction methods rely on large-scale 3D annotations and generalize poorly across environments. We present FreeOcc, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary occupancy prediction from monocular or RGB-D sequences. Unlike prior approaches that require voxel-level supervision and ground-truth camera poses, FreeOcc operates without 3D annotations, pose ground truth, or any learning stage. FreeOcc incrementally builds a globally consistent occupancy map via a four-layer pipeline: a SLAM backbone estimates poses and sparse geometry; a geometrically consistent Gaussian update constructs dense 3D Gaussian maps; open-vocabulary semantics from off-the-shelf vision-language models are associated with Gaussian primitives; and a probabilistic Gaussian-to-occupancy projection produces dense voxel occupancy. Despite being entirely training-free and pose-agnostic, FreeOcc achieves over $2\times$ improvements in IoU and mIoU on EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet compared to prior self-supervised methods. We further introduce ReplicaOcc, a benchmark for indoor open-vocabulary occupancy prediction, and show that FreeOcc transfers zero-shot to novel environments, substantially outperforming both supervised and self-supervised baselines. Project page: https://the-masses.github.io/freeocc-web/.

摘要（中文）：现有基于学习的占据预测方法依赖大规模三维标注，且在不同环境间泛化能力较差。本文提出FreeOcc——一种无需训练的开放词汇占据预测框架，适用于单目或RGB-D序列。与先前需要体素级监督和真实相机位姿的方法不同，FreeOcc无需三维标注、位姿真值或任何学习阶段。该框架通过四层流程逐步构建全局一致的占据图：SLAM骨干网络估计位姿与稀疏几何结构；几何一致的高斯更新构建稠密三维高斯地图；基于现成视觉语言模型获取的开放词汇语义与高斯基元关联；概率化的高斯-占据投影生成稠密体素占据。尽管完全无需训练且不依赖位姿信息，FreeOcc在EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet数据集上相较先前自监督方法实现了IoU和mIoU超过2倍的提升。我们进一步提出ReplicaOcc——室内开放词汇占据预测基准数据集，并证明FreeOcc能够零样本迁移至新环境，显著优于有监督和自监督基线方法。项目页面：https://the-masses.github.io/freeocc-web/。

Authors: Zeyu Jiang, Changqing Zhou, Xingxing Zuo, Changhao Chen

Framework for Collaborative Operation of Autonomous Delivery Vehicles Within a Marshaling Yard AutonomousDriving

autonomous vehicles vehicle coordination decentralized orchestration priority scoring facility throughput

简要说明：提出了一种用于编组场内自动驾驶配送车辆协调的分散式动态优先级评分系统，通过仿真验证了其提高车辆吞吐量并减少拥堵的效果。

TLDR: Proposes a decentralized dynamic priority scoring system for autonomous delivery vehicle coordination in a marshaling yard, demonstrating increased throughput and reduced gridlock in simulation.

Abstract: As autonomous vehicles slowly deploy into urban roads for limited use cases with significant edge case issues, closed facilities like marshaling yards provide a ripe case for combining lower-level vehicle autonomy with fixed infrastructure to create full autonomy without similar edge case concerns. Within a delivery marshaling yard, electric fleet vehicles complete a set of sequential tasks (charging, inspection, cleaning, and loading) before exiting the yard with their new load of deliveries. Hybrid automation of the vehicles and infrastructure can allow these vehicles to reach full autonomy and navigate the facility without the need of a driver, allowing for quicker movement between tasks increasing vehicle throughput. However, isolated autonomous operations based on static rules are prone to gridlock causing facility failures that temporarily shut down operations. Our orchestrated autonomy solution uses decentralized, dynamic priority scoring of vehicles based on the current status of the marshaling yard to optimally assign vehicles to tasks to increase vehicle throughput. Using a simulated facility with three marshaling yard sizes (small, medium, and large) and three demand levels (low, medium, high), we demonstrated that our orchestration solution increases vehicle throughput above static, isolated autonomy for all combinations of yard size and demand, while reducing facility failures at high demand levels.

摘要（中文）：随着自动驾驶车辆因边缘案例问题显著而仅能有限部署于城市道路，编组场等封闭设施为低级别车辆自主性与固定基础设施的结合提供了成熟条件，可构建无类似边缘案例顾虑的完全自主系统。在配送编组场内，电动车队车辆需依次完成充电、检查、清洁和装载系列任务，随后载运新货物驶离场区。车辆与基础设施的混合自动化可使车辆实现完全自主运行，在无需驾驶员的情况下于设施内自主导航，从而加速任务间转移，提升车辆吞吐效率。然而，基于静态规则的孤立自主操作易导致僵局，引发设施故障并造成运营临时中断。我们提出的协同自主解决方案采用去中心化动态优先级评分机制，依据编组场实时状态对车辆进行最优任务分配，以此提升车辆吞吐量。通过模拟三种规模（小型、中型、大型）编组场与三种需求水平（低、中、高）的组合场景，我们证明该协同方案在所有场区规模与需求组合下均能实现比静态孤立自主方案更高的车辆吞吐量，并在高需求水平下有效降低设施故障发生率。

Authors: James O'Hara, Karl Wunderlich, Gregory Stevens

Flying by Inference: Active Inference World Models for Adaptive UAV Swarms WorldModel

active inference UAV swarm probabilistic world model trajectory planning hierarchical probabilistic inference

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于主动推理的框架，用于无人机群轨迹规划，将组合优化问题转化为层次化概率推理，并使用从专家演示中学习的世界模型。

TLDR: This paper proposes an active-inference-inspired framework for UAV swarm trajectory planning, converting combinatorial optimization into hierarchical probabilistic inference using a learned world model derived from expert demonstrations.

Abstract: This paper presents an expert-guided active-inference-inspired framework for adaptive UAV swarm trajectory planning. The proposed method converts multi-UAV trajectory design from a repeated combinatorial optimization problem into a hierarchical probabilistic inference problem. In the offline phase, a genetic-algorithm planner with repulsive-force collision avoidance (GA--RF) generates expert demonstrations, which are abstracted into Mission, Route, and Motion dictionaries. These dictionaries are used to learn a probabilistic world model that captures how expert mission allocations induce route orders and how route orders induce motion-level behaviors. During online operation, the UAV swarm evaluates candidate actions by forming posterior beliefs over symbolic states and minimizing KL-divergence-based abnormality indicators with respect to expert-derived reference distributions. This enables mission allocation, route insertion, motion adaptation, and collision-aware replanning without rerunning the offline optimizer. Bayesian state estimators, including EKF and PF modules, are integrated at the motion level to improve trajectory correction under uncertainty. Simulation results show that the proposed framework preserves expert-like planning structure while producing smoother and more stable behavior than modified Q-learning. Additional validation using real-flight UAV trajectory data demonstrates that the learned world model can correct symbolic predictions under noisy and non-smooth observations, supporting its applicability to adaptive UAV swarm autonomy.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种专家引导的主动推理启发的自适应无人机集群轨迹规划框架。该方法将多无人机轨迹设计从重复性组合优化问题转化为层次化概率推理问题。在离线阶段，采用带有排斥力碰撞规避的遗传算法规划器生成专家演示样本，并将其抽象为任务、航线和运动三级字典。这些字典用于学习概率世界模型，该模型刻画了专家任务分配如何引导航线序列，以及航线序列如何诱导运动层行为。在线运行时，无人机集群通过构建符号状态的后验信念，并最小化基于KL散度的异常指标（相对于专家推导的参考分布），来评估候选行动。这实现了任务分配、航线插入、运动适应和碰撞感知的实时重规划，无需重新运行离线优化器。在运动层面集成了包括EKF和PF模块在内的贝叶斯状态估计器，以提升不确定环境下的轨迹修正能力。仿真结果表明，该框架在保持类专家规划结构的同时，相比改进Q学习方法能产生更平滑、更稳定的行为。基于真实飞行无人机轨迹数据的进一步验证表明，学习得到的世界模型能在噪声和非平滑观测条件下修正符号预测，证明了该框架对自适应无人机集群自主性的适用性。

Authors: Kaleem Arshid, Ali Krayani, Lucio Marcenaro, David Martin Gomez, Carlo Regazzoni

Can Tabular Foundation Models Guide Exploration in Robot Policy Learning? Other

tabular foundation model policy learning continuous control global exploration surrogate-guided refinement

简要说明：论文提出TFM-S3，一种混合局部-全局方法，使用预训练的表格式基础模型预测候选回报以进行大规模筛选，从而在机器人连续控制策略学习中改善全局探索和样本效率。

TLDR: The paper proposes TFM-S3, a hybrid local-global method that uses a pretrained tabular foundation model to predict candidate returns for large-scale screening, improving global exploration and sample efficiency in robot policy learning for continuous control.

Abstract: Policy optimization in high-dimensional continuous control for robotics remains a challenging problem. Predominant methods are inherently local and often require extensive tuning and carefully chosen initial guesses for good performance, whereas more global and less initialization-sensitive search methods typically incur high rollout costs. We propose TFM-S3, a tabular hybrid local-global method for improving global exploration in robot policy learning with limited rollout cost. We interleave high-frequency local updates with intermittent rounds of global search. In each search round, we construct a dynamically updated low-dimensional policy subspace via SVD and perform iterative surrogate-guided refinement within this space. A pretrained tabular foundation model predicts candidate returns from a small context set, enabling large-scale screening with limited rollout cost. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks show that TFM-S3 consistently accelerates early-stage convergence and improves final performance compared to TD3 and population-based baselines under an identical rollout budget. These results demonstrate that foundation models are a powerful new tool for creating sample-efficient policy learning methods for continuous control in robotics.

摘要（中文）：机器人在高维连续控制中的策略优化仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。主流方法本质上是局部搜索，通常需要大量调参和精心选择的初始猜测才能获得良好性能，而更全局且对初始化不敏感的搜索方法通常需要高昂的滚动成本。我们提出TFM-S3——一种基于表格的混合局部-全局方法，用于在有限滚动成本下增强机器人策略学习的全局探索能力。该方法通过高频局部更新与间歇性全局搜索轮次交替进行。在每一轮搜索中，我们借助奇异值分解构建动态更新的低维策略子空间，并在此空间内执行迭代代理引导优化。预训练的表格基础模型基于少量上下文集合预测候选策略回报，从而能以有限滚动成本实现大规模策略筛选。连续控制基准测试表明，在相同滚动成本预算下，与TD3及基于种群优化的基线方法相比，TFM-S3能持续加速早期收敛并提升最终性能。这些结果证明，基础模型已成为为机器人连续控制创建样本高效策略学习方法的强大新工具。

Authors: Buqing Ou, Frederike Dümbgen

Robot Learning from Human Videos: A Survey Manipulation

human video data robot learning skill transfer data foundations scalable learning

简要说明：该综述全面回顾了从人类视频中学习机器人操作技能的技术，重点关注技能迁移方法和数据基础，以解决机器人数据稀缺问题。

TLDR: This survey comprehensively reviews techniques for learning robot manipulation skills from human videos, focusing on skill transfer methods and data foundations to address robot data scarcity.

Abstract: A critical bottleneck hindering further advancement in embodied AI and robotics is the challenge of scaling robot data. To address this, the field of learning robot manipulation skills from human video data has attracted rapidly growing attention in recent years, driven by the abundance of human activity videos and advances in computer vision. This line of research promises to enable robots to acquire skills passively from the vast and readily available resource of human demonstrations, substantially favoring scalable learning for generalist robotic systems. Therefore, we present this survey to provide a comprehensive and up-to-date review of human-video-based learning techniques in robotics, focusing on both human-robot skill transfer and data foundations. We first review the policy learning foundations in robotics, and then describe the fundamental interfaces to incorporate human videos. Subsequently, we introduce a hierarchical taxonomy of transferring human videos to robot skills, covering task-, observation-, and action-oriented pathways, along with a cross-family analysis of their couplings with different data configurations and learning paradigms. In addition, we investigate the data foundations including widely-used human video datasets and video generation schemes, and provide large-scale statistical trends in dataset development and utilization. Ultimately, we emphasize the challenges and limitations intrinsic to this field, and delineate potential avenues for future research. The paper list of our survey is available at https://github.com/IRMVLab/awesome-robot-learning-from-human-videos.

摘要（中文）：阻碍具身人工智能与机器人技术进一步发展的关键瓶颈在于机器人数据规模化难题。为应对这一挑战，近年来基于人类视频数据学习机器人操作技能的研究领域受到广泛关注，这一趋势得益于海量人类活动视频资源的积累与计算机视觉技术的进步。该研究方向使机器人能够从丰富易得的人类演示资源中被动获取技能，从而为通用机器人系统的规模化学习提供有力支持。为此，我们撰写本综述，旨在对机器人领域基于人类视频的学习技术进行全面而前沿的梳理，重点关注人机技能迁移与数据基础两大维度。首先回顾机器人策略学习的理论基础，继而阐述整合人类视频的核心交互框架。随后提出人类视频到机器人技能的层次化迁移路径分类体系，涵盖任务导向、观测导向与动作导向三大路径，并深入分析其与不同数据配置及学习范式的跨族耦合关系。此外，本研究系统考察了包括常用人类视频数据集与视频生成方案在内的数据基础架构，并呈现数据集开发与使用的大规模统计趋势。最后，我们着重探讨该领域固有的挑战与局限，并勾勒未来研究的潜在方向。本综述相关论文列表详见 https://github.com/IRMVLab/awesome-robot-learning-from-human-videos。

Authors: Junyi Ma, Erhang Zhang, Haoran Yang, Ditao Li, Chenyang Xu, Guangming Wang, Hesheng Wang

Simulating Infant First-Person Sensorimotor Experience via Motion Retargeting from Babies to Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

motion retargeting humanoid robots sensorimotor experience infant development multimodal simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一个运动重定向框架，将婴儿的运动从视频映射到物理和虚拟人形平台上，以模拟其多模态感觉运动体验。

TLDR: This paper presents a motion retargeting framework that maps infant motions from video onto physical and virtual humanoid platforms to simulate their multimodal sensorimotor experience.

Abstract: Motion retargeting from humans to human-like artificial agents is becoming increasingly important as humanoid robots grow more capable. However, most existing approaches focus only on reproducing kinematics and ignore the rich sensorimotor experience associated with human movement. In this work, we present a framework for simulating the multimodal sensorimotor experiences of infants using physical and virtual humanoids. From a single video, our method reconstructs the infant's body configuration by extracting its skeletal structure and estimating the full 3D pose from each frame. Then we map the reconstructed motion onto several developmental platforms: the physical iCub robot and the virtual simulators pyCub, EMFANT and MIMo. Replaying the retargeted motions on these embodiments produces simulated multisensory streams including proprioception (joints and muscles), touch, and vision. For the best-matching embodiment, the retargeting achieves sub-centimeter accuracy and enables a rich multimodal analysis of infant development as well as enhanced automated annotation of behaviors. This framework provides a unique window into the infant's sensorimotor experience, offering new tools for robotics, developmental science, and early detection of neurodevelopmental disorders. The code is available at https://github.com/ctu-vras/motion-retargeting/.

摘要（中文）：随着仿人机器人能力日益增强，从人类到类人智能体的运动重定向技术正变得愈发重要。然而，现有方法大多仅关注运动学再现，忽视了人类运动所伴随的丰富感知运动经验。本研究提出一个通过物理与虚拟仿人平台模拟婴儿多模态感知运动经验的框架。该方法仅需单段视频即可重构婴儿身体姿态：通过提取骨骼结构并逐帧估算完整三维姿态，随后将重建的运动映射至多个发育研究平台——包括物理机器人iCub及虚拟仿真器pyCub、EMFANT与MIMo。在这些实体上复现重定向运动后，可生成模拟的多感官数据流，涵盖本体感觉（关节与肌肉）、触觉及视觉信息。在匹配度最高的实体平台上，运动重定向精度达到亚厘米级，不仅支持对婴儿发育进行多模态分析，还能实现更精准的行为自动标注。该框架为探索婴儿感知运动经验提供了独特窗口，为机器人学、发育科学及神经发育障碍早期检测等领域提供了新工具。代码开源地址：https://github.com/ctu-vras/motion-retargeting/。

Authors: Francisco M. López, Hoshinori Kanazawa, Ondrej Fiala, Yakov Balashov, Valentin Marcel, Lukas Rustler, Miles Lenz, Dongmin Kim, Yasuo Kuniyoshi, Jochen Triesch, Matej Hoffmann

Function-based Parametric Co-Design Optimization of Dexterous Hands Manipulation

dexterous hand co-design parametric framework grasp stability sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人手协同设计的综合参数化框架，统一了手掌结构、手指运动学、指尖几何形状和表面曲率的设计空间，并通过仿真和真实世界的抓取稳定性任务验证了其优化效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces a comprehensive parametric framework for robotic hand co-design, enabling optimization of palm structure, finger kinematics, fingertip geometry, and surface curvatures. It validates the framework on grasp stability tasks in simulation and the real world, aiming to bridge design and control for dexterous manipulation.

Abstract: Despite advances in dexterous hand manipulation, robotic hand design is still largely decoupled from task-driven evaluation and control, limiting systematic optimization. Existing robotic hand co-design approaches are often limited in scope, optimizing a small subset of design parameters. We introduce a comprehensive parametric framework for robotic hand generation that unifies palm structure, finger kinematics, fingertip geometry, and fine-scale surface curvatures within a single design space. Fine geometric features are introduced through parametric surface deformation kernels that directly influence contact interactions. We validate the framework on design optimization in grasp stability tasks in simulation and real-world dynamic scenarios. Our framework produces simulation- and fabrication-ready hand models and will be released as open-source to enable rapid design iteration for dexterous hand co-design optimization frameworks and cross-embodiment policy training and control research.

摘要（中文）：尽管灵巧手操控技术取得了进展，但机器人手的设计在很大程度上仍与任务驱动的评估及控制相脱节，限制了系统化优化。现有的机器人手协同设计方法通常范围有限，仅优化小部分设计参数。我们提出了一种用于机器人手生成的综合参数化框架，将手掌结构、手指运动学、指尖几何形态以及精细尺度表面曲率统一在单一设计空间中。该框架通过参数化表面变形核引入精细几何特征，这些特征直接影响接触交互作用。我们在仿真和真实动态场景中的抓取稳定性任务中，对该框架的设计优化能力进行了验证。该框架可生成直接用于仿真和制造的手部模型，并将作为开源工具发布，以支持灵巧手协同设计优化框架以及跨实体策略训练与控制研究的快速设计迭代。

Authors: Mohammad Amin Mirzaee, Harsh Gupta, Wenzhen Yuan

Learning Tactile-Aware Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation Policies Manipulation

tactile-aware learning quadrupedal loco-manipulation hierarchical policy reinforcement learning zero-shot transfer

简要说明：提出了一个触觉感知的层级学习框架，用于四足机器人移动操作，利用真实世界人类演示训练高层策略，并在模拟中通过强化学习训练全身控制策略，实现零样本迁移到真实世界的接触密集型任务。

TLDR: Presents a tactile-aware hierarchical learning pipeline for quadrupedal loco-manipulation, using real-world human demonstrations for high-level policy and RL in simulation for whole-body control, enabling zero-shot transfer to real-world contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Quadrupedal loco-manipulation is commonly built on visual perception and proprioception. Yet reliable contact-rich manipulation remains difficult: vision and proprioception alone cannot resolve uncertain, evolving interactions with the environment. Tactile sensing offers direct contact observability, but scalable tactile-aware learning framework for quadrupedal loco-manipulation is still underexplored. In this paper, we present a tactile-aware loco-manipulation policy learning pipeline with a hierarchical structure. Our approach has two key components. First, we leverage real-world human demonstrations to train a tactile-conditioned visuotactile high-level policy. This policy predicts not only end-effector trajectories for manipulation, but also the evolving tactile interaction cues that characterize how contact should develop over time. Second, we perform large-scale reinforcement learning in simulation to learn a tactile-aware whole-body control policy that tracks diverse commanded trajectories and tactile interaction cues, and transfers zero-shot to the real world. Together, these components enable coordinated locomotion and manipulation under contact-rich scenarios. We evaluate the system on real-world contact-rich tasks, including in-hand reorientation with insertion, valve tightening, and delicate object manipulation. Compared to vision-only and visuotactile baselines, our method improves performance by 28.54% on average across these tasks.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人的运动操控通常依赖于视觉感知和本体感知。然而，实现可靠的接触密集型操作仍然具有挑战性：仅凭视觉和本体感知无法准确应对与环境之间不确定、动态变化的交互作用。触觉感知能够提供直接的接触可观测性，但适用于四足运动操控的可扩展触觉感知学习框架仍处于探索不足的状态。本文提出了一种具有分层结构的触觉感知运动操控策略学习框架。该方法包含两个核心组成部分：首先，我们利用真实世界的人类演示数据训练触觉条件化视觉-触觉高层策略。该策略不仅能够预测操控所需的末端执行器轨迹，还能生成表征接触如何随时间演化的动态触觉交互线索。其次，我们在仿真环境中进行大规模强化学习训练，得到能够跟踪多样化指令轨迹与触觉交互线索的触觉感知全身控制策略，并实现向真实世界的零样本迁移。通过二者的协同作用，本系统能够在接触密集型场景中实现协调的运动与操控。我们在真实世界接触密集型任务中评估了该系统性能，包括插入过程中的手持重定向、阀门拧紧和精细物体操作等场景。与纯视觉基线及视觉-触觉基线相比，本方法在这些任务中的平均性能提升达到28.54%。

Authors: Pokuang Zhou, Yuhao Zhou, Quan Luu, Seungho Han, Heng Zhang, Binghao Huang, Yunzhu Li, Arash Ajoudani, Zhengtong Xu, Yu She

The Field of Safe Motion: Operationalizing Affordances in the Field of Safe Travel Using Reachability Analysis AutonomousDriving

safety model reachability analysis driving behavior kinematic models collision-free escape route

简要说明：本文提出安全运动场（FSM），一种通过可达性分析和运动学模型，将无碰撞逃生路径概念操作化的定量驾驶安全模型。

TLDR: The paper introduces the Field of Safe Motion (FSM), a quantitative safety model for driving by operationalizing the concept of a collision-free escape route using reachability analysis and kinematic models.

Abstract: We present the Field of Safe Motion (FSM), a quantitative safety model for determining whether a driver maintains a collision-free escape route, or "out," at any given moment by accounting for that driver's physical capabilities and the foreseeable actions of other road users. The Field of Safe Travel (FST) provides a framework for representing the types of sensory information and actions available to drivers. However, the FST has remained conceptual in nature since its initial publication almost 90 years ago -- and a concrete computational operationalization is still lacking. At the same time, reachability analysis provides a quantitative basis for assessing the possible actions available to road users, using interpretable kinematic models, but reachability models have so far remained confined largely to the engineering and robotics literature. Bringing these two approaches together provides for an interpretable, quantitative tool for assessing driving behavior across a wide range of driving scenarios. Beyond being interpretable, our approach relies on a relatively small set of basic assumptions that are easy to enumerate and reason about. Furthermore, an interpretable reachability model paired with kinematic assumptions provides a way to bound uncertainty about road users' reasonably foreseeable future locations. We demonstrate the applicability of the FSM to different driving scenarios and discuss the strengths and weaknesses of the model.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了安全运动场（FSM）这一量化安全模型，用于通过考虑驾驶员的物理能力及其他道路使用者的可预见行为，判断驾驶员在任意时刻是否保持无碰撞逃逸路径（即“出路”）。安全行驶场（FST）为表征驾驶员可获取的感知信息与可执行操作类型提供了理论框架。然而自近90年前首次提出以来，FST本质上仍停留在概念层面，至今缺乏具体的计算实现方法。与此同时，可达性分析通过可解释的运动学模型，为评估道路使用者可能采取的行动提供了量化基础，但该模型目前主要局限于工程与机器人学研究领域。将这两种方法相结合，我们创造了一种可解释的量化工具，能够适用于各类驾驶场景的行为评估。除可解释性外，本方法仅依赖少量易于列举和推理的基本假设。此外，可解释的可达性模型与运动学假设相结合，能够限定道路使用者合理可预见未来位置的不确定性范围。我们通过不同驾驶场景验证了FSM的适用性，并讨论了该模型的优势与局限性。

Authors: Leif Johnson, Trent Victor, Johan Engström

Towards Neuro-symbolic Causal Rule Synthesis, Verification, and Evaluation Grounded in Legal and Safety Principles AutonomousDriving

neuro-symbolic rule synthesis causal framework autonomous driving formal verification

简要说明：本文提出了一种神经符号框架，用于从高层次目标合成和验证形式规则，并在自动驾驶场景中进行了概念验证。

TLDR: The paper introduces a neuro-symbolic framework for synthesizing and verifying formal rules from high-level goals, with a proof-of-concept in autonomous driving scenarios.

Abstract: Rule-based systems remain central in safety-critical domains but often struggle with scalability, brittleness, and goal misspecification. These limitations can lead to reward hacking and failures in formal verification, as AI systems tend to optimize for narrow objectives. In previous research, we developed a neuro-symbolic causal framework that integrates first-order logic abduction trees, structural causal models, and deep reinforcement learning within a MAPE-K loop to provide explainable adaptations under distribution shifts. In this paper, we extend that framework by introducing a meta-level layer designed to mitigate goal misspecification and support scalable rule maintenance. This layer consists of a Goal/Rule Synthesizer and a Rule Verification Engine, which iteratively refine a formal rule theory from high-level natural-language goals and principles provided by human experts. The synthesis pipeline employs large language models (LLMs) to: (1) decompose goals into candidate causes, (2) consolidate semantics to remove redundancies, (3) translate them into candidate first-order rules, and (4) compose necessary and sufficient causal sets. The verification pipeline then performs (1) syntax and schema validation, (2) logical consistency analysis, and (3) safety and invariant checks before integrating verified rules into the knowledge base. We evaluated our approach with a proof-of-concept implementation in two autonomous driving scenarios. Results indicate that, given human-specified goals and principles, the pipeline can successfully derive minimal necessary and sufficient rule sets and formalize them as logical constraints. These findings suggest that the pipeline supports incremental, modular, and traceable rule synthesis grounded in established legal and safety principles.

摘要（中文）：基于规则的系统在安全关键领域依然至关重要，但常常面临可扩展性不足、脆弱性以及目标误设等挑战。这些局限性可能导致奖励破解和形式化验证失败，因为人工智能系统往往倾向于优化狭隘目标。在先前的研究中，我们开发了一种神经符号因果框架，该框架将一阶逻辑溯因树、结构因果模型与深度强化学习整合于MAPE-K循环中，以在分布偏移下提供可解释的适应性调整。本文通过引入一个元层级进一步扩展该框架，该层级旨在缓解目标误设问题并支持可扩展的规则维护。此层级包含目标/规则合成器与规则验证引擎，能够根据人类专家提供的高层自然语言目标与原则，迭代精炼形式化规则理论。合成流程采用大语言模型实现以下功能：（1）将目标分解为候选因果因素，（2）整合语义以消除冗余，（3）将其转化为候选一阶逻辑规则，（4）构建必要且充分的因果集合。随后，验证流程依次执行（1）语法与模式验证，（2）逻辑一致性分析，以及（3）安全性与不变性检查，最终将已验证的规则集成至知识库。我们在两个自动驾驶场景中通过概念验证实现对该方法的评估。结果表明，基于人类设定的目标与原则，该流程能够成功推导出最小必要且充分的规则集，并将其形式化为逻辑约束。这些发现表明，该流程支持基于既定法律与安全原则的增量式、模块化且可追溯的规则合成。

Authors: Zainab Rehan, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Sona Ghahremani, Holger Giese

Graph World Models: Concepts, Taxonomy, and Future Directions WorldModel

graph world models relational inductive biases structured representation prediction planning

简要说明：本文提出了图世界模型（GWMs）的统一框架，用于利用图结构表示和模拟环境，并基于关系归纳偏置提出了一个分类法。

TLDR: This paper introduces Graph World Models (GWMs), a unified framework for representing and simulating environments using graph structures, and proposes a taxonomy based on relational inductive biases.

Abstract: As one of the mainstream models of artificial intelligence, world models allow agents to learn the representation of the environment for efficient prediction and planning. However, classical world models based on flat tensors face several key problems, including noise sensitivity, error accumulation and weak reasoning. To address these limitations, many recent studies use graph structure to decompose the environment into entity nodes and interactive edges, and model virtual environments in a structured space. This paper systematically formalizes and unifies these emerging graph-based works under the concept of graph world models (GWMs). To the best of our knowledge, GWMs have not yet been explicitly defined and surveyed as a unified research paradigm. Furthermore, we propose a taxonomy based on relational inductive biases (RIB), categorizing GWMs by the specific structural priors they inject: (1) spatial RIB for topological abstraction; (2) physical RIB for dynamic simulation; and (3) logical RIB for causal and semantic reasoning. For each model category, we outline the key design principles, summarize representative models, and conduct comparative analyses. We further discuss open challenges and future directions, including dynamic graph adaptation, probabilistic relational dynamics, multi-granularity inductive biases, and the need for dedicated benchmarks and evaluation metrics for GWMs.

摘要（中文）：作为人工智能的主流模型之一，世界模型使智能体能够学习环境表征以实现高效预测与规划。然而，基于扁平张量的经典世界模型面临若干关键问题，包括噪声敏感性、误差累积以及推理能力薄弱。为突破这些局限，近期许多研究采用图结构将环境分解为实体节点与交互边，在结构化空间中对虚拟环境进行建模。本文系统性地将这类新兴的基于图的研究工作形式化，并统一于图世界模型的概念框架之下。据我们所知，目前尚未有研究将图世界模型明确定义并梳理为统一的研究范式。此外，我们提出基于关系归纳偏置的分类法，依据模型注入的具体结构先验对图世界模型进行归类：（1）面向拓扑抽象的空间关系归纳偏置；（2）面向动态模拟的物理关系归纳偏置；（3）面向因果与语义推理的逻辑关系归纳偏置。针对每个模型类别，我们阐述其核心设计原则，综述代表性模型，并展开对比分析。进一步，我们探讨了当前面临的开放挑战与未来研究方向，包括动态图适配、概率化关系动力学、多粒度归纳偏置，以及对专用基准测试与评估指标的需求。
