Authors: Jiawei Liu, Senqiao Yang, Mingjun Wang, Yu Wang, Bei Yu

Towards All-Day Perception for Off-Road Driving: A Large-Scale Multispectral Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark AutonomousDriving

multispectral perception off-road driving temporal freespace detection infrared dataset memory-attention mechanism

简要说明：作者提出了IRON数据集，这是一个用于全天候越野可通行区域检测的大规模多光谱（红外+RGB）数据集，并提出了IRONet，一种利用记忆注意力机制聚合历史上下文的无光流时序模型，以实现鲁棒的感知。

TLDR: The authors introduce the IRON dataset, a large-scale multispectral (infrared + RGB) dataset for off-road freespace detection across all-day conditions, and propose IRONet, a flow-free temporal model leveraging historical context via memory-attention for robust perception.

Abstract: Off-road nighttime autonomous driving suffers from unreliable visible-light perception, making infrared modality crucial for accurate freespace detection. However, progress remains limited due to the scarcity of annotated infrared off-road datasets and the inter-frame inconsistencies inherent to current single-frame methods. To address these gaps, we present the IRON dataset, which, to our knowledge, is the first large-scale infrared dataset for off-road temporal freespace detection under all-day conditions, with strong support for nighttime perception. The dataset comprises 24,314 densely annotated infrared images with synchronized RGB images in diverse scenes and different light conditions. Building upon this dataset, we propose IRONet, a novel flow-free framework for temporal freespace detection that addresses inter-frame inconsistencies by aggregating historical context via a memory-attention mechanism and a carefully designed mask decoder. On our IRON dataset, IRONet achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 82.93%(+1.19%) IoU and 90.66%(+0.71%) F1 score at real-time inference. Remarkably, IRONet also exhibits robust generalization to RGB modalities on ORFD and Rellis datasets. Overall, our work establishes a foundation for reliable all-day off-road autonomous driving and future research in infrared temporal perception. The code and IRON dataset are available at https://github.com/wsnbws/IRON.

摘要（中文）：野外夜间自动驾驶受限于可见光感知的不可靠性，使得红外模态成为实现精确可通行区域检测的关键。然而，当前研究因缺乏带标注的红外野外数据集以及现有单帧方法固有的帧间不一致问题而进展有限。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了IRON数据集——据我们所知，这是首个面向全天候条件下野外时序可通行区域检测的大规模红外数据集，尤其对夜间感知提供了有力支持。该数据集包含24,314张密集标注的红外图像及同步的RGB图像，涵盖多样化场景与不同光照条件。基于此数据集，我们提出IRONet——一种新型的无光流时序可通行区域检测框架，通过记忆注意力机制和精心设计的掩码解码器聚合历史上下文信息，有效解决了帧间不一致问题。在IRON数据集上，IRONet以实时推理速度达到了最优性能，分别获得82.93%（+1.19%）的IoU和90.66%（+0.71%）的F1分数。值得注意的是，IRONet在ORFD和Rellis数据集上也展现出对RGB模态的强泛化能力。总体而言，我们的工作为全天候可靠野外自动驾驶及红外时序感知的未来研究奠定了基础。代码与IRON数据集已公开于https://github.com/wsnbws/IRON。

Authors: Shuo Wang, Jilin Mei, Wenfei Guan, Shuai Wang, Yan Xing, Chen Min, Yu Hu

LA-Pose: Latent Action Pretraining Meets Pose Estimation AutonomousDriving

latent action pretraining inverse-dynamics camera pose estimation self-supervised learning driving videos

简要说明：该论文提出LA-Pose方法，将驾驶视频中通过逆动力学预训练学习的潜在动作表征重新用作相机姿态估计器的输入，以极少的3D标注数据实现强性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes LA-Pose, a method that repurposes latent action representations learned via inverse-dynamics pretraining from driving videos as inputs to a camera pose estimator, achieving strong performance with minimal 3D annotations.

Abstract: This paper revisits camera pose estimation through the lens of self-supervised pretraining, focusing on inverse-dynamics pretraining as a scalable alternative to the current trend of fully supervised training with 3D annotations. Concretely, we employ inverse- and forward-dynamics models to learn latent action representations, similar to Genie from large-scale driving videos. Our idea is simple yet effective. Existing methods use latent actions in their original capacity, that is, as action conditioning of world-models or as proxies of robot action parameters in policy networks. Our method, dubbed LA-Pose, repurposes the latent action features as inputs to a camera pose estimator, finetuned on a limited set of high-quality 3D annotations. This formulation enables accurate and generalizable pose prediction while maintaining feed-forward efficiency. Extensive experiments on driving benchmarks show that LA-Pose achieves competitive and even superior performance to state-of-the-art methods while using orders of magnitude less labeled data. Concretely, on the Waymo and PandaSet benchmarks, LA-Pose achieves over 10% higher pose accuracy than recent feed-forward methods. To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate the power of inverse-dynamics self-supervised learning for pose estimation.

摘要（中文）：本文从自监督预训练的视角重新审视相机姿态估计问题，重点关注逆动力学预训练方法，将其作为当前依赖三维标注的全监督训练范式的可扩展替代方案。具体而言，我们采用逆动力学与前向动力学模型来学习潜在动作表征，其原理类似于Genie模型从大规模驾驶视频中学习的方式。我们的思路简洁而高效：现有方法通常将潜在动作用于其原始功能——或作为世界模型的动作条件输入，或作为策略网络中机器人动作参数的代理表征。而本文提出的LA-Pose方法创新性地将潜在动作特征重新定位为相机姿态估计器的输入，并在有限的高质量三维标注数据上进行微调。该框架在保持前馈计算效率的同时，实现了精准且泛化能力强的姿态预测。在驾驶基准数据集上的大量实验表明，LA-Pose在使用少几个数量级的标注数据情况下，仍能达到与最先进方法相当甚至更优的性能表现。具体而言，在Waymo和PandaSet基准测试中，LA-Pose的姿态精度较近年提出的前馈方法提升超过10%。据我们所知，本研究首次揭示了逆动力学自监督学习在姿态估计任务中的强大潜力。

Authors: Zhengqing Wang, Saurabh Nair, Prajwal Chidananda, Pujith Kachana, Samuel Li, Matthew Brown, Yasutaka Furukawa

Learning-Based Hierarchical Scene Graph Matching for Robot Localization Leveraging Prior Maps Other

scene graph matching robot localization SLAM BIM zero-shot generalization

简要说明：一种基于学习的层次化场景图匹配方法，用于机器人定位，利用BIM等先验地图通过零样本泛化来纠正SLAM中的漂移。

TLDR: A learned hierarchical scene graph matching method for robot localization, leveraging prior maps like BIM to correct drift in SLAM via zero-shot generalization.

Abstract: Accurate localization is a fundamental requirement for autonomous robots operating in indoor environments. Scene graphs encode the spatial structure of an environment as a hierarchy of semantic entities and their relationships, and can be constructed both online from robot sensor data and offline from architectural priors such as Building Information Models (BIM). Matching these two complementary representations enables drift correction in SLAM by grounding robot observations against a known structural prior. However, establishing reliable node-to-node correspondences between them remains an open challenge: existing combinatorial methods are prohibitively expensive at scale, and prior learned approaches address only flat graph matching, ignoring the multi-level semantic structure present in both representations. Here we present a learned, end-to-end differentiable pipeline that augments both graphs with semantically motivated edge types encoding intra- and inter- level relationships, explicitly exploiting this hierarchy to enable simultaneous matching from high-level room concepts down to low-level wall surfaces. Trained exclusively on floor plans, the proposed method outperforms the combinatorial baseline in F1 on real LiDAR environments while running an order of magnitude faster, demonstrating viable zero-shot generalization for BIM-assisted robot localization.

摘要（中文）：精确的定位是机器人在室内环境中实现自主运行的基础需求。场景图将环境的空间结构编码为语义实体及其关系的层次化表示，其既可通过机器人传感器数据在线构建，也可基于建筑信息模型（BIM）等先验知识离线生成。通过匹配这两种互补的表示，能够将机器人观测数据与已知结构先验进行锚定，从而实现SLAM中的漂移校正。然而，在这两种表示之间建立可靠的节点级对应关系仍是一个开放挑战：现有组合方法在大规模场景中计算代价过高，而现有的学习方法仅能处理平面图匹配问题，忽略了两种表示中均存在的多层级语义结构。本文提出一种端到端可微分的学习框架，该框架通过引入编码层内与层间关系的语义化边类型对两种图结构进行增强，显式利用这种层次结构实现从高层房间概念到底层墙面的一体化匹配。该方法仅在平面图上进行训练，在真实激光雷达环境中以比组合基线方法快一个数量级的速度运行，并在F1指标上表现更优，证明了BIM辅助机器人定位具备可行的零样本泛化能力。

Authors: Nimrod Millenium Ndulue, Jose Andres Millan-Romera, Matteo Giorgi, Holger Voos, Jose Luis Sanchez-Lopez

Bridging Values and Behavior: A Hierarchical Framework for Proactive Embodied Agents Other

hierarchical cognitive architecture value scheduling LLM-based planning PDDL planner self-directed behavior

简要说明：提出一种分层认知架构ValuePlanner，利用LLM进行基于价值的高层子目标规划，并通过PDDL规划器执行底层动作，在家庭模拟环境中评估其生成长期、自主行为的能力。

TLDR: Proposes a hierarchical cognitive architecture, ValuePlanner, that uses an LLM for high-level value-based subgoal planning and a PDDL planner for low-level action execution, evaluated in a household simulation for generating long-horizon, self-directed behavior.

Abstract: Current embodied agents are often limited to passive instruction-following or reactive need-satisfaction, lacking a stable, high-order value framework essential for long-term, self-directed behavior and resolving motivational conflicts. We introduce \textit{ValuePlanner}, a hierarchical cognitive architecture that decouples high-level value scheduling from low-level action execution. \textit{ValuePlanner} employs an LLM-based cognitive module to generate symbolic subgoals by reasoning through abstract value trade-offs, which are then translated into executable action plans by a classical PDDL planner. This process is refined via a closed-loop feedback mechanism. Evaluating such autonomy requires methods beyond task-success rates, and we therefore propose a value-centric evaluation suite measuring cumulative value gain, preference alignment, and behavioral diversity. Experiments in the TongSim household environment demonstrate that \textit{ValuePlanner} arbitrates competing values to generate coherent, long-horizon, self-directed behavior absent from instruction-following and needs-driven baselines. Our work offers a structured approach to bridging intrinsic values and grounded behavior for autonomous agents.

摘要（中文）：当前具身智能体往往局限于被动遵循指令或反应式需求满足，缺乏对长期自主行为与动机冲突解决至关重要的稳定高阶价值框架。我们提出\textit{ValuePlanner}——一种将高层价值调度与底层动作执行解耦的分层认知架构。该架构采用基于大语言模型的认知模块，通过抽象价值权衡推理生成符号化子目标，再经由经典PDDL规划器转化为可执行的动作序列，整个过程通过闭环反馈机制持续优化。评估此类自主性需超越传统任务成功率指标，为此我们构建了以价值为核心的评估体系，从累积价值增益、偏好对齐度和行为多样性三个维度进行度量。在TongSim家庭环境中的实验表明，\textit{ValuePlanner}能够仲裁竞争性价值，生成遵循指令型与需求驱动型基线所缺失的连贯、长程、自主行为。本研究为构建连接内在价值与具身行为的自主智能体提供了结构化路径。

Authors: Chunhui Zhang, Yuxuan Wang, Aoyang Qin, Yi-Long Lu, Kunlun Wu, Yizhou Wang, Wei Wang

Beyond Gaussian Bottlenecks: Topologically Aligned Encoding of Vision-Transformer Feature Spaces WorldModel

variational autoencoder hyperspherical latent geometry-aware world model point cloud reconstruction

简要说明：本文提出了一种使用超球面潜在分布的几何感知变分自编码器，以在视觉世界模型中更好地保留3D结构和相机动态，在深度估计和点云重建等任务中优于高斯瓶颈。

TLDR: The paper proposes a geometry-aware variational autoencoder using hyperspherical latent distributions to better preserve 3D structure and camera dynamics in visual world models, outperforming Gaussian bottlenecks in tasks like depth estimation and point cloud reconstruction.

Abstract: Modern visual world modeling systems increasingly rely on high-capacity architectures and large-scale data to produce plausible motion, yet they often fail to preserve underlying 3D geometry or physically consistent camera dynamics. A key limitation lies not only in model capacity, but in the latent representations used to encode geometric structure. We propose S$^2$VAE, a geometry-first latent learning framework that focuses on compressing and representing the latent 3D state of a scene, including camera motion, depth, and point-level structure, rather than modeling appearance alone. Building on representations from a Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), we introduce a novel type of variational autoencoder using a product of Power Spherical latent distributions, explicitly enforcing hyperspherical structure in the bottleneck to preserve directional and geometric semantics under strong compression. Across depth estimation, camera pose recovery, and point cloud reconstruction, we show that geometry-aligned hyperspherical latents consistently outperform conventional Gaussian bottlenecks, particularly in high-compression regimes. Our results highlight latent geometry as a first-class design choice for physically grounded visual and world models.

摘要（中文）：摘要：现代视觉世界建模系统日益依赖高容量架构与大规模数据来生成逼真运动，但往往难以保持底层三维几何结构或物理一致的相机动态。核心局限不仅在于模型容量，更在于用于编码几何结构的潜在表示方法。我们提出S$^2$VAE——一种以几何为核心的潜在学习框架，专注于压缩和表征场景的潜在三维状态（包括相机运动、深度及点级结构），而非仅建模外观表现。基于视觉几何锚定变换器（VGGT）的表示方法，我们引入一种新型变分自编码器，采用幂球面潜在分布的乘积形式，在瓶颈层显式强化超球面结构，以在强压缩条件下保持方向与几何语义。在深度估计、相机位姿恢复和点云重建任务中，几何对齐的超球面潜在表示始终优于传统高斯瓶颈，尤其在高度压缩场景下表现显著。我们的研究结果表明，潜在几何结构应成为物理基础视觉与世界模型的首要设计要素。

Detecting is Easy, Adapting is Hard: Local Expert Growth for Visual Model-Based Reinforcement Learning under Distribution Shift WorldModel

model-based reinforcement learning distribution shift JEPA representation local expert action correction

简要说明：提出JEPA索引的局部专家增长方法，用于视觉模型强化学习，通过添加局部动作修正来应对分布偏移，同时保持原始分布上的性能。

TLDR: Proposes JEPA-Indexed Local Expert Growth, a method for visual model-based RL that adds local action corrections to handle distribution shifts without degrading in-distribution performance.

Abstract: Visual model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents can perform well on the training distribution, but often break down once the test environment shifts. In visual MBRL, recognizing that a shift has occurred is often the easier part; the harder part is turning that recognition into useful action-level correction. We study several ways of responding to shift, including planning penalties, direct fine-tuning, global residual correction, and coarse gating. In our experiments, these approaches either do not improve closed-loop control or hurt in-distribution (ID) performance. Based on these negative results, we propose JEPA-Indexed Local Expert Growth. The method uses a frozen JEPA representation only for problem indexing, while cluster-specific residual experts add local action corrections on top of the original controller. The baseline controller itself is not modified. Using paired-bootstrap evaluation, we find that the original naive-preference variant is not stable under stricter testing. In contrast, the harder-pair variant produces statistically significant OOD improvements on all four evaluated shift conditions while preserving ID performance. The learned experts also remain useful when the same shift is encountered again, which supports the view of adaptation as incremental knowledge growth rather than repeated full retraining. We further show that automatic ID rejection can be achieved with simple density models, whereas fine-grained discrimination among OOD sub-families is limited by the representation. Overall, the results indicate that, for visual MBRL under distribution shift, the main challenge is not simply noticing that the environment has changed, but applying the right local action correction after the change has been recognized.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉模型的强化学习（MBRL）智能体在训练分布上表现良好，但一旦测试环境发生偏移，其性能常常会显著下降。在视觉MBRL中，识别出偏移的发生往往相对容易，难点在于如何将这种识别转化为有效的动作级修正。本研究探讨了应对偏移的多种策略，包括规划惩罚、直接微调、全局残差校正和粗粒度门控机制。实验结果显示，这些方法要么未能改善闭环控制效果，要么损害了分布内（ID）性能。基于这些负面结果，我们提出了JEPA索引的局部专家增长方法。该方法仅使用冻结的JEPA表示进行问题索引，而由集群特化的残差专家在原始控制器基础上添加局部动作修正，基线控制器本身保持不变。通过配对自助法评估，我们发现原始朴素偏好变体在严格测试下表现不稳定；相比之下，困难配对变体在全部四种评估偏移条件下均产生了统计显著的分布外（OOD）性能提升，同时保持ID性能不变。当再次遭遇相同偏移时，学习到的专家仍能保持有效性，这支持了将适应过程视为渐进知识增长而非重复全面重训练的观点。我们进一步证明，通过简单密度模型可实现自动ID样本过滤，但对OOD子类别的细粒度判别能力仍受表征限制。总体而言，结果表明：对于分布偏移下的视觉MBRL，核心挑战不仅在于察觉环境变化，更在于识别变化后如何实施恰当的局部动作修正。
